title: Daniel C. Dennett: Do Lobsters Have Free Will?
description: Daniel C. Dennett is the most influential contemporary philosopher of the mind and a great reformer in the field of knowledge. For half a century he has been searching for answers to the following questions: What is consciousness? What is free will? Is faith a natural phenomenon? The film is a recording of a one-to-one meeting with the philosopher at his home in northern New England.

title: Hear Me, Mommy? Now Let's Get Rich!
description: The Goddess of Wealth, Ann Lowe, is reincarnated as Eva Shaw’s unborn daughter, whom she is carrying in her womb. Ann soon learns that the powerful Lowe family and her father, Cory Lowe, plan to cast Eva aside because she is carrying a daughter. From within the womb, Ann guides Eva to build a fortune in stocks and shine at auctions. Mother and daughter join forces to defeat her biased father and rise to become the world’s top billionaires.

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: CEO's Cute Charm For Love
description: Song Yujia and Lu Huanyu's new drama begins with a special marriage. In the marriage, the man went abroad with a third party, and the two lived based on an agreement not to interfere with each other. The heroine Xu Wenyan chose to support a gigolo in response. Two years later, when her husband, who was married in disguise, returned to China, it foreshadowed the resurgence of this complicated relationship - Xu Wenyan's relationship with the gigolo came to an end. At the same time, the prince of the Beijing circle, who had been silently supporting the heroine, decided not to hide his true feelings and identity anymore, and strived to spend the rest of his life with the heroine as a formal partner, starting a battle for love and identity.

title: Baby Chef Is Not Someone To Mess With
description: A six-year-old culinary prodigy, Katherine, fights to save her critically ill mother, Master Renee. Her remarkable talent draws the attention of Heinz Group CEO Leon, sparking a showdown with ruthless rivals, ultimately culminating in their family's reunion and the Golden Fork crown.

title: IS-22
description: After the world is taken over by a virus, Chase Aimers (a survivalist) is trying to lead a group to a Infection Station known as IS-22. They will find out that having each other is their best way of survival.

title: Dragon Prince Yuan
description: A young man with his brush plunges into a chaotic world and lights up the heavens. In a world where cultivators are paramount, will the vermilion bird swallow the dragon, or will the dragon transcend beyond all else?

title: Salad Days
description: "Salad Days: A Decade of Punk in Washington, DC (1980-90)" examines the early DIY punk scene in the Nation's Capital. It was a decade when seminal bands like Bad Brains, Minor Threat, Government Issue, Scream, Void, Faith, Rites of Spring, Marginal Man, Fugazi, and others released their own records and booked their own shows-without major record label constraints or mainstream media scrutiny. Contextually, it was a cultural watershed that predated the alternative music explosion of the 1990s (and the industry's subsequent implosion). Thirty years later, DC's original DIY punk spirit serves as a reminder of the hopefulness of youth, the power of community and the strength of conviction.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

title: Echoes of a Daydream
description: A troubled young man gets the unique opportunity to spend one more day with his deceased mother before she returns to heaven.

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

title: (Dubbed) She Took Everyone on Vacation Except Me!
description: (Dubbed) She Took Everyone on Vacation Except Me!

title: Reborn to Build an Empire
description: Reborn in a fallen kingdom, Gavin Thorne is captured with a group of female refugees. Then he awakens a nation-building system: the more people he saves, the more powerful his rewards. With his fierce female army by his side, he'll turn a wasteland into an empire.

title: Midnight Breaks
description: When sweet-voiced Cassie (Dawn Hope) of unsigned reggae act Midnight is offered a lucrative deal to join successful group Breaks by record company rep Billy (Toyah Willcox), her bandmate boyfriend Tyron (Letts) is less than thrilled.

title: Africa Adventure
description: A true film account of a three-month safari in the big game hunting areas of the Dark Continent, undoctored with any faked plot or contrivance.

title: SYSTÈME : MA PDG CRAQUE
description: SYSTÈME : MA PDG CRAQUE

title: The Magic Brush Millionaire: Drawing My Superstar Lover
description: Broke street artist Chris receives a magical brush that brings anything he paints to life. After creating a living portrait of Hollywood superstar Shirley, he uses his gift to rise from poverty, defeat a corrupt gallery owner and a controlling agent, and protect the real Shirley. As miracles blur the line between art and reality, Chris builds an artistic empire—and wins the heart of the woman who inspired it all.

title: Fake Marriage with My CEO Bestie
description: Si-Ah has no idea that her childhood friend Jun-Woo has been in love with her all his life. So when Si-Ah approaches Jun-Woo to propose a contract marriage to fool her parents, he jumps at the chance. Even though they try to keep things platonic, the more time they spend together, the more uncertain their relationship becomes.Why do you have to keep kissing me? And why am I starting to like it?

title: Unexpected Knot: My Husband Is a Tycoon (DUBBED)
description: Forced into marriage by her manager at the shoe store, Olivia Sullivan quickly weds a divorced father with two kids. While she expects an ordinary married life, she soon discovers that her husband is, in fact, the wealthiest man in the city!

title: Swallowed Star S1-S2
description: This series follows the protagonist, Luo Feng, in a post-apocalyptic world full of intelligent Monsters, as he becomes a warrior (superhuman) and gradually improves by overcoming various difficulties.

title: Rooftops
description: A touring musician returns home to spend time with old friends and an old flame for a day. Just as times begin to feel right again, she has to reckon with leaving again.

title: Kisses Laced with Lies
description: A leaked video shatters Stella Quinn's reputation and ends her relationship with her boyfriend—who had been playing her for her sister, Willow Quinn. In despair, Stella takes Willow's place in an arranged marriage and exposes what she did. With her new partner, Stella steps into a new life—but her ex isn't ready to let her go just yet.

title: It's My Turn
description: A successful but stressed mathematics professor goes to her father's wedding and falls in love with the son of her new stepmother.

title: How to Become an Action Star in Ten Weeks (The True Story of How I Found Love)
description: A lonely banker decides to transform himself into an action star (like Jean Claude Van Damme) in only ten weeks! He aims to improve his life and as a result of accomplishing his goal meets his soul mate.

title: (Dubbed) The Short King of Basketball
description: (Dubbed) The Short King of Basketball

title: The Volunteers: The Battle of Life and Death
description: It tells the story of the third to fifth battles in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, among which Battle of Cheorwon will be the highlight. Li Xiang , Fu Chongbi, Cai Changyuan from 63rd Army and others will come on Stage.

title: A Twist of Fate
description: Laurel York has been secretly loving Sean Leon since childhood but never dared to approach him due to her insecurities about her appearance. As adults, a twist of fate brought them together, but Laurel, fearing rejection, chose to hide her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else impersonated her, leading to a series of misunderstandings. Fortunately, the two ultimately overcame the obstacles and misunderstandings, finding happiness together.

title: One Punch Man vs. Mosquito
description: Is One-Punch Man unbeatable or did a mosquito expose him? The unending battle between man and bug rages on.

title: Caché Derrière Les Roses ( Doublé )
description: Pour jauger sa fiancée Zoé, le milliardaire Maël se glisse à la fac en se faisant passer pour un étudiant défavorisé. Zoé le désigne comme cobaye d'un jeu. Elle simule une cour assidue, ayant parié avec ses complices qu'elle l'abandonnerait en un mois. Maël entre dans la danse tout en contrôlant chaque mouvement en coulisses, et ceux qui se croyaient prédateurs deviennent des proies. Il transforme la chasse en condamnation publique retentissante de la jeunesse dorée.

title: The Lion God Goes Full Beast Mode
description: The Lion God Won't Let Me Go - FULL MOVIE ENGLISH SUB

title: A Summertime Drug
description: Stand up Comedian Louis C vents about his childhood, adulthood and relentless failures with relationships. A Summertime Drug was filmed during back to back nights for 2 sold out crowds at The Stage Door in Elko, NV.

title: The Hunt of the Son of Beast
description: Andrew, David and his friends are taking a vacation to Kings Island when something strange and mysterious is happening and it's returning.

title: Be Passionately in Love
description: Zhi Xu, a top student, meets Luzhou Chen, a troublemaker with a violent past, during the summer after her college entrance exam. Despite their contrasting reputations, an unexpected connection forms between them.

title: [Doublé] Il ne reste plus toi dans ma vie
description:
Sophie, véritable dirigeante du Groupe Célestia, avait renoncé à son rôle au sommet de l’entreprise afin de soutenir son mari Alex. Elle s’était volontairement retirée pour devenir femme au foyer, et avait consacré sept années entières à prendre soin de sa famille. Elle avait même veillé sur Alex lorsqu’il avait été gravement malade, l’ayant accompagné sans relâche jusqu’à sa guérison, en y mettant toute son énergie et toute sa tendresse.



Cependant, cet amour qu’elle avait donné sans compter s’était transformé en une trahison totale. Le jour même de la cérémonie des cent jours de leur fils Léo, Alex a ramené sa maîtresse Emma ainsi que son fils illégitime Félix. Sous la complaisance de ses parents, Alex a imposé à Sophie un choix injuste : soit accepter la cohabitation avec Emma et Félix et continuer à servir la famille Bernard, soit divorcer sans pouvoir emmener son enfant.

title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream

description: Joan White, heir to the White Group, was betrayed by her sister and fiancé, left for dead at sea. She survived, but with the mind of a child. With her past restored, will her revenge begin?

title: Oops, I’m the Billionaire You Dumped
description: Before leaving for Africa, Kang Do-hyun proposed to Kim Ji-min. Five years later he returns; Ji-min, now a Harvard PhD, dumps him for a chaebol heir—never asking who he really is: the chairman of Titan Group. Flying home, heiress of Summit Group, Lee Chae-won, begs him for a one-year contract marriage. He refuses, but secretly rewrites her 100-billion proposal into 1,000 trillion. Mocked as a fraud, he hides his name—until the truth breaks, and everyone who mocked him kneels.

title: Sniper Butterfly
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.

title: The Heir
description: In the middle of Ming Dynasty, a tribute ink case broke the long-standing pattern of Huizhou ink industry, and Li Mo, a century-old family of ink making, fell to the altar. Li Mo's vitality was greatly damaged, and the ink industry of the Luo family rose, and the scenery was no two after Li Mo. Finally, due to the involvement of the government, the family was also destroyed. As time goes by, Li Zhen (Yang Zi is acted the role of), the eighth female of the Li clan, resolutely embarked on the road of making ink to solve the livelihood, and became the dark horse of Huizhou ink industry with talent and efforts. Luo Wenqian, the second son of the Locke family (Han Dongjun is acted the role of) to restore the layout of the family business, to stir up the pattern of Huizhou ink industry. They two people and ink industry upstart field ink family battle of wits and courage, Li Mo back to the top. In the face of the challenges of overseas ink industry, Li Zhen collected the essence of Huizhou ink industry, produced top ink products, and won the reputation of "the first ink in the world" for Huizhou ink. Li Zhen and Luo Wenqian finally got married and worked together to promote the passing down of Huizhou ink to the world.

title: Werewolf King's Hidden Heir
description: Human girl Nellie, drunk, stumbles into werewolf king Clifford's territory, has a one-night stand with him, and flees. Five years later, she applies to be his family doctor for her sick son Brady—only to discover her employer is the man from that night. Recognizing her, Clifford relentlessly pursues her while Brady's werewolf blood awakens. Werewolf nobles repeatedly frame Brady as a "cursed child" and try to kill him, but Clifford protects his family. At their wedding, he exposes the conspiracy and proves Brady's pure lineage. Nellie accepts his proposal, Brady gains the pack's acceptance, and the three live happily ever after.

title: Love Has Fireworks
description: Follows Qian Fei, who was forced to start the challenging process of reorganizing her life and profession after her fiance left her. She then meets Li Yifei who is completely opposite to her.

title: Rejected Siren, Chosen by the Prince
description: Voiceless Alicia trusts Rayne, unaware she's a pawn in his revenge. Forced to marry the "Mad Prince" Kane, she's framed and tortured as Rayne watches. Her hidden bloodline awakens. At Rayne's engagement, she exposes the lies, leaving proudly with Kane. Kane isn't mad—just tormented by the sea's cries—and together they heal. Consumed by obsession, Rayne wages war for her but fails. He's imprisoned; Shelly ruined. Voice restored, Alicia guards the deep sea with Kane.

title: The Princess's Gambit
description: A former princess enters an arranged marriage with a prime minister. Amidst political turmoil, she navigates loyalty conflicts, vengeance, and love while he conceals patriotic motives behind his ambitions.

title: Roses for My Little Moon
description: At 15, Evan Jose met the love of his life. Having been diagnosed with a rare illness since childhood and given no more than 30 years to live, Evan tasted a candy from Tina Skyler, and that very candy drove away his misery. Over the years, Evan kept supporting Tina, watching his little moon grow into an exceptional dancer. When he had only 7 months left to live, he made a selfish decision. He married her, aiming to love her silently, as he had done for the past 14 years. But he forgot that the look of love can't be hidden. His feelings grew stronger. He reveled in her cute yet awkward attempts to please him, was captivated by her unintentional touches, and couldn't bear the thought of any other man near Tina. With his life slipping away and his love impossible to let go, a countdown of love began.

title: Generation to Generation
description: Cai Zhao, from a well-known family, was forced to become a disciple of the Qingque Sect because of her destiny to be a "witch". She unexpectedly met Chang Ning who was recovering in the sect after his entire family was slaughtered.

title: Quantum G-d
description: Quantum G-d is a 96 pages script and a presentation deck, for a science documentary, written, from the scientific optics, by scientists from the California Institute of Technology, Caltech, listed as the most important institute of technology in the world, and one of the main universities along with Harvard, MIT and Oxford. Throughout the script, the physicists formulate questions and provide the answers through different professional perspectives according to each area of study. This is accompanied with a series of mind blowing, never before seen animations that will be used in schools to teach quantum physics for an entire generation. The script, which includes the pointed questions and the novel animations, will challenge the top minds in theoretical physics to re-evaluate our ideas of how the universe works through the lens of quantum entanglement. One of the writers serves as the manager for Caltech's Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, and he was a scientific consultant in Marvel's blockbuster movies, including Ant Man, Spider Man Homecoming, Ant Man and the Wasp, Infinity War, Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, Avengers: Endgame and Fantastic Voyage (dir: Guillermo del Toro, prod: James Cameron). The narrative was constructed with the help of another scientist, a cell and molecular pathologist and research associate at the Doheny Eye Institute in Los Angeles, who co-wrote the viral shorts films, "Anyone Can Quantum" and "Quantum is Calling" which featured Stephen Hawking, Paul Rudd, Keanu Reeves, Zoe Saldana, Simon Pegg and John Cho respectively.

title: Niya vs Sin-D
description: Niya and Sin-D exchange armwork and go-behinds as the two grapple for position and advantage in this evenly matched bout. Sin-D finally escapes and ensnares Niya in a Hammerlock, but soon finds herself trapped in a grinding Side Headlock. Sin-D takes the momentum with an eye rake, then tosses Niya into the turnbuckles and delivers numerous shoulder blocks to Niya’s back in the corner. Niya battles back with a knee to the gut, followed by a Headbutt, but Sin-D stops her in her tracks with a Chinbreaker. The two struggle for supremacy on the mat, where one wrestler locks on a bodyscissors, then adds a Sleeperhold to put her foe out cold on the canvas for a hard-fought victory.

title: Bulli e pupe
description: After journeying through the Italy of the "musicarelli" from the 1960s with Nessuno mi può giudicare, Della Casa turns his attention to post-WWII archives. title: E-Team
description: When atrocities are committed in countries held hostage by ruthless dictators, Human Rights Watch sends in the E-Team (Emergencies Team), a collection of fiercely intelligent individuals hired to document war crimes and report them to the rest of the world. Within this volatile climate, filmmakers Ross Kauffman and Katy Chevigny take us to the frontline in Syria and Libya, where shrapnel, bullet holes, and unmarked graves provide mounting evidence of coordinated attacks conducted by Bashar al-Assad and the now-deceased Muammar Gaddafi. The crimes are rampant, random, and often undocumented, making E-Team's effort to get information out of the country and into the hands of media outlets and criminal courts all the more necessary.

title: Dayereh-e zangi
description: Mohammad is sent to an apartment situated in uptown Tehran to install their satellite dishes, while having satellite TV is illegal in Iran. He arrives there with a girl named Shirin who seems to be his girlfriend and is in need of some money to repair her father's car with which she has had an accident the day before. title: e-Life
description: Computers, smart phones, and tablets are now a part of our daily lives. They have revolutionised the way we work, the way we communicate and the way we view the world. But what happens to our old phone when we upgrade? Where does our broken computer go after we throw it out? e-Life explores what happens to our electrical goods when we throw them away and exposes some unpleasant (and perhaps unknown) truths about the detrimental affects e-waste has on people's health, the environment and the economy. From consumers in the UK to the recyclers in the dumps of Ghana, the documentary will follow the journey of our e-waste. We will examine current manufacturing and disposal processes and also assess the burden the boom in electronic goods is placing on global resources. e-Life will be an objective portrayal of the problem of ewaste that documents the issue through carefully crafted cinematography.

title: Dil-E-Nadaan
description: Vikram together with his childhood, orphan friend, Anand is raised by his mother, brother likely. Anand and a young woman named Asha is in love with each other. Quite unknown to the couple that Vikram is in love with Asha. Vikram and Anand is employed by the same organization and here is where Anand gets knowledge of Vikram's love for Asha only to step aside for Vikram to wed Asha but a major draw-back intercept the three lives when Anand gets intimate with a widow named Sheela resulting in her getting pregnant.

title: Gafas e Pallaso
description: Gafas e Pallaso are two characters of a reality that is not governed by the same parameters as ours. The contact with other forms of life resulting from the free intergalactic transit and the miscegenation that this entails, as well as the peculiar religious idols or hegemonic alcoholic beverages whose image is a football myth, not to mention rare parallel worlds or space-time flirtations , Demonstrate what we say. The protagonists are the best proof of this: a clown of race who comes from another planet with a magic band, and an individual whose sunglasses are part of him as his chest hairs. Within this cosmology we can consider various particular and picturesque species and individuals, but also a series of everyday elements that make up a whole with a characteristic and identifiable personality: a monopolistic beer whose corporate image is the legendary porter Oliver Kahn, Excellence, a somewhat special religion - ingredients that impregnate and uniquely characterize the world in which the stories of the series pass.

title: Sabbia e ferro
description: Carlo Volontè, Born in 1921, talks about his experience of war in Africa. title: E muet
description: Nanou's first true love story comes to an abrupt end. Rajwa treads carefully into a monogamous relationship. From 2008 to 2013, I accompanied them through their stories of passion and anguish, carrying with them their determination to arrive at the heart of things: to enter the hidden crevices of love, to uncover truth, all for the ever-elusive goal of understanding the essence of their own complex personalities. I entered their world to find answers to my own questions, to use their lives as my lens into discovering new forms of love. I stand at the intersection of friendship, love and seduction, unable to express the extent of my fascination for these women.

title: Mass E Bhat

title: Mulheres e Milhões
description: Após ser cruelmente abandonado pela sua ex-namorada Wang Feifei, que foge com um herdeiro rico, Jiang Fan, Su Chen é humilhado e acaba se envolvendo em um acidente de carro. Essa tragédia desperta o misterioso "Sistema de Retorno Centuplicado", que recompensa Su Chen com 100 vezes o valor que ele gasta com mulheres. Com seu poder recém-adquirido, a vida de Su Chen se transforma enquanto ele conhece quatro mulheres fascinantes — Liu Qingyan, Su Wan'ning, Xia Linlin e Han Mengyao. Enquanto Wang Feifei e Jiang Fan zombam dele, acusando-o de ser "mantido", a ascensão de Su Chen ao topo acaba superando suas mais loucas imaginações.

title: F**k Buddies
description: F*ck Buddies, we see a middle-aged man on his couch drinking a glass of scotch, when his daughter walks in, sits next to him and takes a swig. "How's your sex life?," he asks her, matter-of-factly. They drone on about his date and her new friends and when the scene ends, she replies, "to answer your question, it's going pretty amazing." The effect the show is going for is cool and casual; just a father-daughter duo knocking back after a tough day at work. But then you watch it again and notice that there's nothing else in the scene. It doesn't lead to anything nor does it reveal something new about Jiah (Jikki Nair), the show's protagonist. And when you realize that the father doesn't get a second scene in the show, you sense a problem. The scene was written exclusively for its shock value. Which is ok if the show was trying to achieve something that was truly shocking. Even its central concept, about two friends "benefitting" with no strings attached, isn't exactly fresh. Other than the novelty of such a scenario being set in Chennai, it isn't rocket science for it to be explained. The contrived "Rules of F*ck Buddies" for instance. 'No going out', is one. 'No texting or calling' is another. Not only are these rules spelled out, but they are written up, framed and hung on Jay's (Jaytesh) bedroom wall. For people trying to keep things casual without labels, they seem extremely finicky about the rules. It's a show that tries too hard to be hip and progressive, but in the process, it reduces millennials to a bunch of alcoholic dimwits with nothing but sex on their minds. How about some texture while writing these characters? I know nothing about Jay, even after the whole show, other than he's a YouTuber (don't know what kind) and that he's a "wet dhummer"(someone who only smokes when he drinks). The same goes for Jiah. She's free and sexually liberated but does every single scene have to play out exactly the same way. It's hinted that she has some sort of a disease but it's neither serious enough to do some real damage nor is it used in such a way that it contributes to the screenplay. F*ck Buddies is a show so excited to be able to use the F word (and its many iterations) that it forgets that those words have to also make sense. And for all its progressive take on a modern relationship, one wishes they'd taken a ballsier stand. What's more to say about a show whose only intention is to make the audience go WTF.

title: The F Word
description: Robert Adanto's The F Word explores radical "4th wave" feminist performance through interviews with a new generation of feminist artists who use their bodies as subject matter. Because the female body continues to be politicized and policed, and because these artists delve into the fecund territory of female sexuality, self-objectification, and the female form as a site of resistance, many remain marginalized by the mainstream art world. Brooklyn-based Leah Schrager, well known for her performance practice, Naked Therapy, states, "As soon as you introduce a bit of sexiness or sexuality into an artwork it suddenly becomes questionable. Just because something elicits arousal or shows elements of sexiness does absolutely not make it not art." While some 4th wave artists, like Ann Hirsch and Kate Durbin, choose to analyze representations of female identity through digital media, others, like the radical, queer, transnational feminist art collective, Go! Push Pops, explore sexuality and gender in pop culture in the digital age. As feminist lecturer Kristen Sollee explains, 4th wavers, unlike their predecessors, "are not afraid to be 'girly', (or) to be hyper-feminine, or to wear a mini-skirt, to self-objectify" in the service of challenging patriarchal oppression or sexist ideals. Dr. Kathy Battista, Director of Contemporary Art at Sotheby's Institute of Art, New York and author of Re-negotiating the Body: Feminist Artists in 1970s London (IB Tauris, 2012), is an on-screen expert, as are noted art critic and curator, Nancy Princenthal, and feminist lecturer, Kristen Sollee.

title: I Against I
description: Focusing on the timeless themes of jealousy, murder and betrayal, 'I Against I' is set over one night and utilises different time lines to reveal a dark and unexpected conclusion to a simple mystery premise. The main protagonists, opposite in character, take a frantic journey into a desolate nocturnal world with the common aim of survival, though once completed, the plot reveals a trap from which escape may be impossible. Taking influence from films like 'Le Samurai', 'Point Break', and new Asian noir, the film is a modern homage to hard boiled cinema with its own original take.

title: I Remember When I Die
description: If the human concept of time ceases at the moment of death, is it then physically possible to experience eternity? Can we affect this last moment in life? Can we build our own eternity? 'I Remember When I Die' takes partly place at life's last destination, a hospice - and is partly shot in a land of memories and provocative choices. We meet the patients, their stand-ins and their dreams. Death is a process. Not black and white. If you could hold on to a memory forever, which one would it be? A highly original journey into the mystery of consciousness.

title: Channel K
description: Half-hour series comprised of shorter segments, all lampooning TV programming, all intentionally in bad taste. Included "Bachelor Pad," where love guru Chad Randolph offered tips to single dudes on how to score chicks while on a budget; "Bikini Beat," where police badges come on skimpy bathing suits; "The Handy Dan Show," where an incompetent do-it-your-self expert showed the TV audience why to never do it yourself; "Life Styles of the Poor and Unkbown," a glamorous look at the not-so-glamorous lives of the under-privileged; "Too Hip," about a pair of Simease twins joined at the hip, one neat, one sloppy, who serve as police detectives; "6 and 1/2 Minutes," an investigative news magazine uncovering stories not big enough for prime time; and "Gomer Hiel, N.A.Z.I.," following the madcap adventures of an inept soldier in the World War II German army, among others.

title: Opus K
description: A freelance journalist is hired by a psychiatrist to investigate the death of a patient, but as the case progresses he fears he is being groomed to replace the dead man. Or worse: join him.

title: The Secret Life of My Secretary
description: After Do Min Ik, a competent director, loses his ability to recognise faces, he becomes dependent on Jung Gal Hee, his secretary, and eventually develops feelings for her.

title: My Love from Another Star [Hindi]
description: Do Min-Joon, an alien that came to our planet 400 years ago, will be able to return to his planet in 3 months, but when he meets famous actress Chun Song-Yi, all the centuries he spent distancing himself from humans come to an end.

title: Badla
description: Ramnagar is a simple beautiful village. Bharati Devi is a very honourable and respected Lady who loves her village. She is the chief of the local Panchayat of Ramnagar. She always backs the rights of the common people. Bharti devi lives in a very expanded family with all his sons and daughter. Sonaton is a very cruel and dishonest person who believes that Bharti Devi is responsible for his father's death. But everybody knows that was a mere accident. Sonaton conspires against her and tries to grab the property of Bharti Devialong with two of her eldest son who he manages to convice. But he knows that he has a hurdle in front of him called Arjun. Arjun is the brother of those two conspirators. He always works for the wellness and rights of the villagers, every single villager loves him and they believes him as their friend. On the other hand an urban girl Nanda came to Ramnagar and falls in love with Aarjun. But her mother wants her to marry Rudra who eventually is the brother of Sonatan. Then after lots of struggle Arjun became victorious over the cruel thought of Sonaton and won her love.

title: Don't Dare to Dream
description: Getting ahead in a broadcasting station is tough and the competition is fierce -- but when a news anchor and meteorologist start to fall for each other, things get much more complicated.

description: A philosophical adventure biopic, 08.20 is a contemporary story of a young Moscow photographer in search of meaning, contribution and purpose. He rejects a safe, well-fed and quiet future, then struggles to transcend his austere childhood. His goal: transform the surrounding Russian bleakness into vivid color photographs. To develop his artistic sensibility, a method: destroy the rational, the educated mind. Take risks, shoot heroin, experiment with sex and techno. His artworks grow, the Universe has his back. He dodges bullets, runs from cops and dupes his parents. To mature as a pro, he moves to Paris, the city of photography. Where he clashes with consumerism, post-modernism and the art establishment. So he amplifies the reckless habits, approaches the revelation. Until his new French girlfriend sways him towards comfort, advertising projects, money, health and family. Good fortune? Or a fatal mistake? Can he have it all? Or has he left the path of self-realization? Spanning 3 decades, the film portrays the work and doubts of a photojournalist, as he confronts the ethics of war photography, dives into music press awash with drugs, then photographs extreme sports (climbing, cycling, aerobatics and sailing), searching for his artistic core, questioning the boundaries between an artist and a sell-out. Shot in Moscow, Ural, Paris, Berlin, the Atlantic Ocean and the Alps; out of sequence, scene by scene, it assembles a puzzle of debauchery and sadness, of pleasure and sacrifice, of free will and fate. A dialogue of cultures, in English, French and Russian. A visually-stunning love story, with an abrupt and ambiguous ending.

title: Il mistero di Lovecraft - Road to L.
description: 1997: A student of folklore named Andrea Roberti hypothesizes the possible link between the horror literature of H.P. Lovecraft and the dark folk tales of the Po Delta, a mysterious and remote part of northern Italy. 2002: One of the directors of the film comes across a manuscript in Montecatini (Italy) which may have belonged to the American writer. This journal, dated 1926, describes travels in Italy through the Po Delta in search of inspiration in the form of local folk stories: the Filò Tales. 2004: A small, tough crew of international filmmakers is put together with the help of David, a New York actor, to make a documentary on the finding of the journal and on the links between Lovecraft and the Po Delta. If the manuscript really did belong to Lovecraft, it would be an extraordinary discovery. As soon as they begin, however, the filmmakers find that Andrea Roberti disappeared in mysterious circumstances many years before, his car found abandoned on the banks of the Po. The crew sets up its base in the town of Loreo - referred to simply as L. in the manuscript - as the author of the journal did. During their investigations the atmosphere of animosity and foreboding rises and they soon discover that strange and disturbing things have been happening in the area. Events that the locals are eager to keep secret. The film "Road to L." is the true account of what took place behind the scenes of the 11 day shoot, reporting how the failures and revelations experienced in L. came to resemble ever more a journey to... Hell. Did Lovecraft really come into contact with something sinister? Did Andrea Roberti stumble across something he wasn't meant to find? The documentary makers are stepping too far into the unknown...

title: I Only Want You to Love Me
description: A man is interviewed by a sympathetic woman. His tale unfolds, of hard work that never pleases his parents, of a father who denigrates his efforts, of an indifferent mother. He builds them a house. Instead of offering their flat to him and his bride, they give the flat up, so he goes to Munich to work in construction, bringing his wife who is soon pregnant. They buy things on credit; he works overtime. He shows up with flowers and expensive gifts. When construction slows and he works less overtime, he cannot adjust his spending habits: he needs to be loved. Pressures mount. When he snaps, and violence ensues, who will be his victim?

title: D.N. Angel
description: Not-so-average teenager, Daisuke Niwa, has had an abnormal life. His mother and grandfather have trained him his whole life by setting up traps that can kill him if he doesn't figure them out.

title: Thumb N It
description: A shy withdrawn country lad is watching Global Citizens music video Broken Doll over and over and he becomes fixated on the girl starring in the video.

title: Crash N Burn
description: A mild-mannered high school band teacher fills in for a flamboyant 80's hair band frontman in a 'Monsters of Rock' world tour.

title: Love N Success
description: Money changes everything.

title: Comics N Cocktails
description: The awkwardest duo around, from Awkward Conversations on Nerd Reactor, bring you Comics 'n Cocktails! Drinking booze and chatting about comic-books, superheroes, sci-fi, games, cult films, fantasy stories, magic, Star Wars, technology, Star Trek, cosplaying...and did we mention drinking booze? Anastasia 'Darth Boobs' Washington and Nathan 'Angry Baby' Lichtman sit down with nerdy guests and ask them the awkward questions you always wanted to... and did we mention there's drinking?

title: Tricks 'n' Tracks
description: The series of magic, music, tricks and tips. With Paul Zenon , Sally Gray , resident robots Arbie, Adam and Eve, and Russ Stevens performing some dazzling illusions.

title: Hill 'n' Gully
description: Ten year old Sara Sapphire attacks a kid who taunts her in class, gets suspended for a week and can only return to school if her mother takes her to a psychiatrist to deal with her explosive temper. Dr. Moses discovers that the angry root in Sara grows even deeper in her mother, Carin Shiquita and her grandmother who suffers from agoraphobia. During her week of suspension, Sara Sapphire goes to work with Carin. There, photographer Caleb Foster, who is painfully shy, frequents the restaurant in which Carin works hoping to take her picture and ask her out on a date...not just any date, but his first date ever!

title: BL!N Magazine
description: BLIN Magazine, a member of the DEPO media group, is an information portal for "a new rhythm of life".

title: Wild 'N Out S6-S21
description: Watch as Nick Cannon and a new A-list celebrity lead a team of improv comedians each week as they compete against each other in the new show: Nick Cannon Presents Wild 'N Out.

title: Rise 'n Shine Og

As is the case with all of us, some of Og's days start out on the right foot and some (most) do not, but regardless of how it begins she always manages to give the day an interesting spin... or does the day manage to give her a spin? description: Unable to change his brother's mind, who's decided to marry off his daughter to a wealthy compatriot, a progressive uncle sets his sights on helping his niece and her beau. Can Uncle Ippokratis save the day and let love shine through?

title: Confronto o Roteiro, Encontro o Amor
description: Bianca desperta no corpo da nora submissa dos Navarro. Decidida a mudar seu destino, enfrenta o marido frio e expõe a hipocrisia da irmã adotiva. O inesperado? Sua conexão com Vinícius — o tio influente que antes só impunha regras, agora fascinado por sua coragem. Enquanto Henrique tenta reparar seu erro, ela prova que uma vítima pode se tornar protagonista.

title: Nazm-o Nasr, Qowl-o Qazal
description: This concert was performed in September 2011 in Niavaran Cultural Center.

title: O emporakos
description: An honest medical student, who sells newspapers to make ends meet, falls in love with an affluent young woman with big, sad eyes. But, a shameless theft taints his immaculate reputation. Can an orphaned pedlar help him clear his name?

title: O Amuleto
description: Moçambique beach in Florianópolis, have a lot of unsolved murders cases. One day, Diana, Alex, Paulinho and Marcinha went to a party in the forest. In the next day, three teenagers are found death. Diana is the only survivor, but she doesn't remember what happen. The only thing that will help to solve the case is the videos recorded with their cell phones.

title: O filos mou o Lefterakis
description: Thodorakis is a womanizer who lies to his wife about having a friend who lives in Patra in order to cover his dirty business. What happens when this fake friend appears in front of him and the night before he is ready to go with his mistress?

title: O Cavalariço Governa o Reino.
description: O herdeiro Roland Valen é forçado a se esconder após uma força misteriosa aniquilar sua família. Depois que a nobre Isabella o acolhe como cavalariço, ele passa dois anos ocultando as mortais habilidades de combate no polo que o fizeram temido em todo o reino. Mas, quando um implacável príncipe estrangeiro toma Isabella como alvo e ameaça a Casa Astra, Roland precisa sair das sombras e provar que o cavalariço que todos desprezavam é muito mais perigoso do que parece.

title: Harry O
description: After being shot in the line of duty, Harry Orwell was forced to retire from the San Diego Police Department. To supplement his police pension, Harry runs a private detective agency out of his beach house.

title: O, schastlivchik!
description: Recently, Slavik has started to question the meaning of life and he has not found a positive or satisfactory answer. On the brink of suicide and about to end it all, Slavik is offered a chance to alter the outcome of his life.

title: O Assalto
description: Lucas is in trouble, he has only a week to pay he's debts to Gomez. So he comes up with a plan and forms a team to steal a necklace that contains potential clues to a hidden treasure.

title: O Gado Deu o Troco
description: Leonardo fez de Marcela a rainha de Wall Street, mas foi empurrado de um telhado por ela e Breno no dia do próprio casamento. Ao abrir os olhos novamente, Leonardo se vê de volta à época da faculdade. Tendo essa nova chance, ele jura viver apenas para si, chega de ser o gado da Marcela. Ele até encontra alguém novo: a jovem herdeira da Família Holanda...

title: O Secunda
description: One second it's all it takes for lives to unravel, either you loose everything you hold dear or you get a new chance.

title: O Asymvivastos
description: Pavlos a young man full of dreams is questioning the Status quo and decides to quit medical school and become a street musician. He meets Apostoli Flou and the wandering begins.

title: O Casarão
description: Three moments in the life of a coffee farmer and his family, from the early 1900s to 1976.

title: O tsarlatanos
description: An immigrant in Germany works hard to be able to live his family in Greece. When eventually forced to return, he discovers that he hasn't a damn, because the bank has bankrupted. So returns hidden in a car-fridge and arrives frozen.

title: O gynaikas
description: When it comes to women, a rotund philanderer and managing director of his wife's family business is incapable of keeping himself under control, until one day, he crosses the line. Will his right-hand man always be there to save him?

title: O anipsios mou, o Manolis
description: After a misunderstanding, a simple man is considered to be the expected rich nephew of a family.

title: Jack-O
description: Teens vandalize a grave on Halloween and accidentally free an evil being called Jack-O.

title: O trellopenintaris
description: A failed businessman who accepts to pose as a rich ship owner to break into high-end social circles, falls for a wealthy widow, unbeknownst to him that his official fiancée is not prepared to lose him. Will she bring him to his senses?

title: O ouranokatevatos
description: Yearning to see his beloved family one last time to lend them a helping hand, a recently deceased paterfamilias asks dear God for a leave of absence; however, their scandalous misbehaviour is shocking. Can he help them get back on track?

title: O Pistoleiro
description: The film tells the story of three hired killers: one of them is a veteran of the profession; the other is naive, almost mentally weak; and the third is a circumstantial murderer who commits murder for revenge and is forced by a principal to take the path of crime.

title: Selling the OC S1-S4
description: Jason Oppenheim, owner of the Oppenheim Group, expands the company opening a second office in Newport Beach.

title: O Predileto
description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: O Corpo
description: Xavier, a pharmacist, lives peacefully in bigamy with his two women, Carmen and Beatriz, but the harmony breaks down when they find he has another lover, Monique, a nightclub dancer.

title: Quando o Tempo Sela o Amor
description: Um acordo desenrola a perseguição persistente de Kim Woo-jin por Lim Eun-ju. Dizem por aí que ele a ama até os ossos. Acontece que Eun-ju vivia à deriva após o término com seu antigo amor e aceitou o pedido de Woo-jin por impulso. Woo-jin abandona o sonho de ser médico e vira marido em casa, dedicando-se em segredo a desenvolver um medicamento para a alergia dela. Mas ela continua fria, só com Seo Min-ho no coração. Quando Seo Min-ho retorna, Woo-jin pede o divórcio.

title: O Psyllos
description: "O Psyllos" (The Flea) is the title of a newspaper, published by a 12-year-old student, Elias, who lives in a small village on highland Olympia. His dream and its pursuit are thriftily but beautifully illustrated, along with the rural life of the '60s in Greece.

title: Masha e o Urso: O Filme
description: Masha and the Bear: to the cinema. Young girl Masha, who can't sit still and the Bear who likes everything relaxed and in an orderly manner, have many new adventures together. Nice for young children as the adventures themselves take about 7 minutes each.

title: O fovos
description: Lei Bicheng uses the magic to bring Lv Guichen back to life. Xiao Zhou finds out the King's secret.

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: O Gringo
description: The story of Dejan Petkovic 'Rambo', a Serbian footballer who became a legend of Brazilian league and Flamengo in particular.

title: O apithanos
description: Thomas, the owner of an electrical appliances store, is having business problems due to his short-fuse temper and bad luck.

title: Deen-O
description: When a few local kids discover a dormant military operation, magic comes alive and the adventure unfolds as they learn about and defend their new friend Deen-O

title: O Bobo
description: Set four years after the Portuguese revolution and the simultaneous loss of the Portuguese empire in Africa, the story concerns a director who sells guns to finance his play.

title: O aittitos
description: A childless Romani woman abducts the daughter of the prosecutor who imprisoned her. As she trains the child to do her evil bidding, the girl becomes a woman and soon finds herself accused of murder. Can a trainee solicitor clear her name?

title: Tú o nadie
description: A young woman gets involved in a feud between two brothers.

title: O Sobrinho Dele é o Meu Pecado
description: Melanie Thorne é advogada de sucesso, divide escritório com o marido há dez anos e venceu o centésimo caso. George Dearborn volta do exterior para ser nomeado herdeiro da Dearborn Pharmaceuticals; é sobrinho do marido de Melanie. Quando se conhecem, a faísca é imediata e surge um amor intenso. Mas o universo, as famílias e a sociedade se voltam contra eles. Cederão às pressões ou ousarão acreditar que o mundo pertence a eles?

title: O Casarão
description: An old house withers away at the heart of a village ripped in half by a road where cars no longer stop. During the dictatorship, this building was the most progressive Catholic seminary in Portugal. António, the front door neighbor, was brought up and raised a family in its shadow. Ever since the Dominican priests left, he has been its most faithful caretaker - keeper of ghosts, memories, and hallways now emptied of life. Abandoned for years, the town's former epicenter now hopes for a new life.

title: O methystakas
description: A poor cobbler has become a drunkard and the laughing stock of the whole neighborhood, besetting his daughter. When she falls in love with a rich young man, her father tries in vain to hide his passion from his family.

title: O Abhagi
description: A poor family lived in a small village far from the city. Batasa is the only girl in that family. She's dream is to marry a Raj Kumar, but it doesn't happen. On the other hand, Batasas father was always worried about his daughter marriage.

title: O Descarte
description: Claudia (Gloria Menezes) is a wealthy widow, she found in Bruno (Ronnie Von) a new love. But one morning, receives an anonymous letter containing a serious threat.

title: O mestre e o Divino
description: Two filmmakers portray life in the village and in the mission of Sangradouro, Mato Grosso: Adalberto Heide, an eccentric German missionary, that soon after the contact with the Indians, in 1957, starts to film with his Super-8 camera; and Divino Tserewahu, a young Xavante filmmaker, that produces films for television and cinema festivals since the 90's. Shifting between complicity, competition, irony and affect, they give life to their historical records, revealing peculiar back-stages of indigenous catechizing in Brazil...

title: O Milionário
description: A sentimental comedy about toothpicks. A man makes and exchanges toothpicks for numerous products as he ignores money. He is called "The millionaire" and goes through the city, walking, meeting friends, Carlitos, the newspaper seller, and Celeste the lemon seller and living an innocent life, in contrast with the city, filled with traps.

title: O Desejo
description: Widowed one year ago, Eleonora, a 33-year-old woman from Sao Paulo's upper bourgeoisie, lives alone, unsuited to her husband's absence, an intellectual frustrated and torn between the need for transcendence and a strong sexual compulsion. The life of the couple, although not happy, was intense. However, the presence of her a long-time friend Ana Maria, just arrived from Paris, a middle-class university student, is staying at his house. The two go to the site of Eleonora and she remembers her life with Marcelo and his death by drowning.

title: O Pseftothodoros
description: Theodoros comes to Greece from abroad. They welcome him friends and relatives, wanting his fortune.

title: O LODI
description: A rich lady diagnosed of cancer, finds joy in a young man to kill her depressed state. But aside from her erupt cancer, something else wants her dead and very fast too.

title: Jhong, Vhong at Kim, nagpagalingan ng joke
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Walter Pfeiffer: Chasing Beauty
description: At the age of 70, artist and fashion photographer Walter Pfeiffer has reached the height of his career. In the film Chasing Beauty Pfeiffer speaks about his life and work with delightful wit and charming ease. We observe him working with both supermodels and nobodies, as well as drawing in nature, and we witness how real-life situations turn into images with the unmistakable Pfeiffer touch. The dynamic, and sometimes tense relation of art and fashion which Pfeiffer masterfully plays with, is reflected upon by his associates from both fields. Models from four decades talk about their work with Pfeiffer, what made them model for him in the first place, and what his images mean to them today. Incidentally, we also get an overview of youth cultures in past four decades. The film is carried by Pfeiffer's subtle humour, his down-to-earth attitude and authenticity. It's a film that celebrates going your own way and leaves you with a smile on your lips.

title: P're hanggang sa huli
description: Copper Guerrero (Andrew E.) is a police man who just arrests a group of cattle rustlers and teams up with Brando del Valle (Robin Padilla) who was insulted by their Major due to his stupidity. Brando and Cooper tries to stop some thugs leading to a car chase resulting the thug's car crashes into a gas station destroying it. Cooper was kidnapped along with Jessica (Charlene Gonzales) and her friends by a group of kidnappers led by their leader (Mat Ranillo III). Cooper was tortured by their leader. Brando arrives to rescue him who is helped by a kidnapper who defects and leads them to Jessica in the airport hangar where she is been held by the kidnappers. They defeat the kidnappers and rescues Jessica and her friends while Brando kills the leader who tries to escape on a plane. One of the defeated kidnappers still alive and badly injures Jing-Jing (Angelu De Leon) who notices this and jumps on Brando protecting from the gunshot and Brando throws his army knife at the still alive kidnapper and Cooper kills it. They mourn Jing-Jing as the Major and his police forces arrives who congratulate Brando but he respectfully rejected his promotion and orders a suspension from his position and he kindly accepts his offer and Brando hands him his badge. The defected kidnapper leaves on a motorcycle turning out that he was also a police officer who was sent by the Major to help him on the mission. Some time later Brando and Cooper had a romance with Jessica and her friend in the train.

title: Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa Miss Q&A
description:
What doesn't kill you makes you stronger, at sa bawat pagsubok ay mas tumatatag ang character. Mula sa Bahay ni Kuya, balik-“Showtime” na si Cianne Dominguez, hawak muli ang mikropono, slay kung slay sa pagpe-perform sa entablado. Group hug para kay Cianne!

Kung ang mood mo ay hindi kagandahan, mga beki ay may hatid kaming bonggang katatawanan. Sa talas ng isip at husay sa talakan, ang Miss Q&A candidates na ang bahalang magpagaan ng 'yong pakiramdam.

Sina Magdalena Fox, Maria Divina Bulawan Gil, at Yems Deligario Espinola, nagpalitan ng mga hirit. Si Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa kanyang pagpapakatotoo at transformation, at sa aktingan niya with Vhong Navarro.

Huwag hayaang malunod sa kalungkutan, sumabay sa alon ng saya at tawanan. Mula sa Dagat-Dagatan, Navotas, ang Madlang Players ay nakipagsapalaran, at baka sa Laro Laro Pick ay makabingwit pa ng malaking papremyo at kasiyahan.

Sa Act-Song round, ang script nila ni Darren Espanto, hindi kinaya ni Jackie Gonzaga sa kanilang aktingan. From one role to another, si Darren 'social distancing' pa rin ang gusto. Ayaw "madamay" kay hindi na lang daw muna siya magmo-move closer kay Cianne.

Sa jackpot round, si Aichelle ang sumabak sa larong may halong kaba. Ang Li-Pot offer na P25,000, tinanggap niya para siguradong may maihahanda sa darating na Pasko para sa pamilya. May panghihinayang nga lang na naramdaman si Aichelle dahil alam pala niya ang sagot sa P150,000 na POT question.

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A Rexy, UMIYAK nang matalo
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, may kakaibang dictionary!
description:
Mula sa iconic na “Jumbo Hotdog” at “Sana Mama” na minsang nagpaindak sa buong nation, nagbabalik to flex their muscles and new single ang grupong Masculados. Grateful ang grupo na makabalik at mabigyan ng pagkakataong ipagpatuloy ang kanilang musika.

Hindi lang ganda ang puhunan, dapat may wit na panlaban. Dahil bawat tanong, kailangang may sagot na papalakpakan ng buong bayan. Kaya naghanda ng matitinding linyahan ang mga Miss Q and A candidates na nagharapan.

Ready magbigay ng tutorial sa ganda at talino ang online tutor na si Precious Alden Ganaden, habang mula pageant coaching ay siya naman ngayon ang sasabak sa sariling laban, si MJ Apin Salada. Naaliw naman ang Madlang People, pati na si Vice Ganda, sa kakaibang dictionary ni Ivanach.

Sa second round na Wit Lang, sina MJ at Ivanach ang nagharap. Sinubok si Ivanach sa tanong na, “Kung lechon ka, mao-offend ka ba kung balat lang ang habol sa ’yo samantalang full package ka naman?” Si MJ naman, napaisip kunngmagtatampo ba ang king cobra kung hindi siya ang king of the jungle.

Ayusin ang display at siguraduhing kumpleto ang stocks at siguruhing available ang swerte. Mula sa pag-aasikaso ng mga produktong mabenta, saglit munang iniwan ng mga merchandisers mula NCR ang kanilang puwesto para subukang i-checkout ang POT money sa “Laro Laro Pick."

Kinilala ng hosts si player Frank, ang loving hubby and addy na baon sa utang. Kaya naman si Tyang Amy Perez, to the rescue bitbit ang payo niyang wais. Love life naman ang usapan nang kanilang lapitan si pplayer Yong, na dinamayan ng hosts matapos malamang hiwalay na sila ng kanyang girlfriend.

Kay Frank talaga napunta ang swerte dahil siya ang umabot sa Jackpot Round! Pero imbes na isugal ang lahat para sa ₱450,000 POT, pinili niyang tanggapin ang ₱35,000 Li-Pot offer para may siguradong maipambayad sa kanyang maraming utang.

title: Ahtisa, pinuri ang Miss Q&A segment
description:
Major throwback feels ang hatid ni New Zealand singer-songwriter na si Bic Runga sa “It’s Showtime” nang kantahin niya ang kanyang hit na “Sway," na bahagi na ng playlist ng maraming Pinoy, lalo na noong ’90s at early 2000s.

Huwag ubusin ang wit, dapat laging may reserba lalo na kung sa 'Miss Q and A' ka eeksena. Pak na pak na palakpakan ang sumalubong kina Mariposa Jem Lacsina, Affarah Deur, at Curevedilol Filipinas Galore as they walked the runway and left the crowd wanting more.

Dahil kakaiba mga pangalan ng mga kandidata, na-curious si Vice Ganda at inalam ang kuwento sa likod ng mga ito. Kung ang "It's Showtime" family naman ang papipiliin, ano ng gusto nilang maging 'beki' name? Back to the pageant, hindi tumalab ang full pack makeup ni Curevedilol sa pabilisan sa pagpindot at pagsagot. Siya ang unang umuwing lotlot. Sina Mariposa at Affarah naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang.

Mga bituin at diskarte ang kanilang gamay para sumakses sa buhay. Swerte ay maningning, kaya POT money ang goal sungkitin ng madlang players mula Tala, Caloocan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick.

Agaw-eksena ang galawan ni player Rian. Kung twerking lang naman kasi ang labanan, si Jackie Gonzaga ay wit niya uurungan. Na-shookt ang everybody, lalo na si Vice Ganda, sa wild moves ni Rian sa dance floor. Para bang makabagong bunot ang peg!

Kinaaliwan naman ni Meme Vice si Gara, isa labandera, dahil super natural lang ng cuteness at charisma nito. Pero naging emotional si Gara nang mapag-usapan ang kanyang asawa. Na-touch si Meme sa kuwento, kaya may pakimkim na agad itong abuinaldo bago pa man dumating ang Pasko.

Kay Gara nga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante! Nadoble pa ang kanyang aguinaldo dahil umuwi siyang may tatlumpung libong piso, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

description: Szeto Ginyi is a young businessman recently returned to Hong Kong to open a branch of a Japanese company. He's been living in a hotel. To save money, he rents from the loquacious Baby - paying three months' rent and a hefty deposit - to share a flat with a lovely unemployed fashion designer, Miss Clary. Clary and Ginyi seem to hit it off, as friends, and he hires her to do the cooking and cleaning while she looks for work. Odd things begin happening, especially late at night: is a ghost on the loose, is Clary possessed, or does the house have a bloody history? Ginyi seeks answers from Keung, a local security guard. Deceptions multiply.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

title: Raine SHOOKT sa naging kapalaran sa Miss Q&A
description:
May mensahe ka ba sa ex mong biglang nag-walkout sa buhay mo? Kung may gustong o-shoutout, aba’y huwag nang mahiya. Katulad ng "It's Showtime" hosts na matapang na humugot tungkol sa kanilang mga TOTGA, at mga ex na minsan silang pinaluha.

Kung si Brent Manalo ay may shoutout sa "dating Big Winner" ng buhay niya, si Ryan Bang naman ay may mensahe sa babaeng naghatid ng pag-ibig na hindi natuloy sa dambana. At si Kim Chiu, hindi raw pinagsisihan si ex pero hindi na niya ito babalikan dahil may mga bagay na dapat ala-ala na lang.

Walang awat din sa pagtalak ang mga Miss Q and A Talaki-Talks of the week na sina Xantie, Raine Garcia, Stacey Doroteo, Adam Lambert, at Dhey Pascual Abital.

Effective ang reminder ni Vice Ganda sa mga accla na maging mas maliksi at witty. Bawal dito ang mababa ang energy. Kaya sunod-sunod ang kanilang pagsagot sa Tumpak Ganern round hanggang si Stacey ang naiwan at dumiretso na sa uwian. Samantala, ang apat ay naglaban-laban sa Wit Lang kung saan umangat sina Raine at Xantie.

Ang Beklamation question of the day, "Kung ikaw ang original jowa, anong gagawin mo sa keridang mas matapang pa umasta kaysa sa'yo?"

Pleasant ang energy kaya pleasant din ang pagpasok ng swerte para sa mga taga-Pleasant Hills, Mandaluyong City na na humataw ay nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick.

Sa moves niyang bigay-todo, kuhang-kuha ni Nanay Inday ang atensyon mo. Ang kuwentuhan, kung saan na napunta. How true na 'nepo mommy' si Inday at low-key rich siya? Tahimik lang din sa 'gedli' si player Badjong pero kapag tinitigan, ay, pang leading man!

Looking for pleasant personality? Meron n'yan si Chel, ang masipag na manikurista na very happy sa love life with her lesbian partner, Shella. Dahil inspired, may extra tapang si Chel na sugalan ang POT question na katumbas na ng P350,000.

Bigo si Chel na maibigay ang tamang sagot. Pero, sabi nga ni Vice Ganda, mahal na mahal niya ang mga kapwa niya members ng LGBT community. Gusto niyang pasayahin sina Chel at Shella, kaya may regalo siyang P20,000 sa couple.

Miss Q&A candidate, dumami ang 'boyfriend' sa studio
description:
Sabi nga nila, after the rain there's a rainbow na naghihintay. Pero hindi pa man natatapos ang buhos ng ulan, kinulayan na ni Heath Jornales ang ating mga buhay sa karisma niyang taglay. Isang kilig harana at magandang balita ang hatid ng "PBB Collab 2.0" Kapuso 2nd Big Placer.

Nagningning ang tatlong kandidata na nagpatalasan ng wit sa Miss Q and A segment. Ready to dominate the 'queendom' of talak sina Xantie, Kendra, at Lancy Empleo. 

Rain or shine, tuloy rin ang puksaan at kulitan ng paborito nating trio sa FUNanghalian, sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Gets na ni Meme Vice ang galawan ng mga kaibigan, kaya nang mapag-usapan ang mga ibong 'parrot,' si Meme na mismo ang bumitaw ng punchline at tinawag ang sarili bilang 'panot.' 

Samantala, sa Wit Lang round ang punta nina Xantie at Lancy kung saan hinarap nila ang magkaibang pageant questions. Bahagyang kinabahan ang mga kandidata, but the effort is appreciated. Besides, nagbigay ng advice si hurado Nicole Cordoves for their improvement. 

Hindi lang candidates ang nag-attempt na sungkitin ang puso ng judges, dahil maging si Ryan Bang ay give na give sa mga jokes as his way to the heart of hurado Max Collins. Kaya para makuha ang loob ng mga kaibigan ni Max, nagpa-impress na rin ang cutie Koreano pati sa ibang hurado.

Kung malamig ang panahon, mainit naman na pinaglabanan sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang POT money na P250,000. Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si player Aubrey, isang cashier na nagbahagi ng karanasan sa mga scammer. Malakas naman ang dating ni player Darren, kaya si Jackie Gonzaga biglang longing. 

Sinuwerte nang todo si Maricel, na nabunot ang pangalan para sa jackpot round matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players. Naging maingat si Maricel sa pagpili, at naging wais hanggang sa huli.

title: Meme Vice, naguluhan sa pagkatao ni Miss Q&A Rexy
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.
