title: Nutridamus! Vice natawa sa mga sagot sa Miss Q&A
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nangakong babalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: Mittal V/S Mittal
description: Girls have dreams - dreams of a fairytale romance, of prince charming sweeping them off their feet, a dream wedding and living happily ever-after. Mitali, a successful model, also had dreams... Then one day she met Karan, the Mittal scion, the heir to one of the richest families in the country. Mitali 's simple, middle-class upbringing is in complete contrast to Karan's super-brat lifestyle. But Karan was smitten by Mitali. Accustomed to getting what he wants in life, Karan landed up at Mitali's home with his parents with a marriage proposal. Delighted at their daughter's luck, Mitali's family approved of the match. And Mitali entered Karan's home and life as his newly-wedded bride. It was not long before Mitali's dreams turned into her worst nightmare. Her mother-in-law detested her and created misunderstandings between Karan and her. Karan turned out to be a puppet in his mother's hands and her father-in-law is a helpless, mute spectator. Karan has a certain pattern of dealing with women and wanted to subdue Mitali's independent streak. He who appeared to be a loving husband was in fact a violent monster at night within the privacy of their bedroom.Unable to bear the humiliation and pain after she resisted his advances and is raped by him,Mitali decided to take charge of her life. She decided to fight back.Mitali walked out of her in-laws home, hired a lawyer and filed a case against her husband. Karan retaliated by hiring the best lawyer money can buy to fight on his behalf. Mittal Vs Mittal is about to he heard in court. It is a case on file that fights for the rights of women like Mitali who are subjugated to domestic violence and inhuman treatment at the hands of husband and in-laws. It is a case that will empower women to fight for their pride, respect and their very right to live with dignity. It is Mitali Mittal versus Karan Mittal...

description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. title: masakra w
description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

title: The Song of the Soul
description: Jerry Wendover, disfigured since childhood after his act of heroism in saving a little girl from a fire scarred his face, secludes himself in an old house in the Backwater district of Florida. One night he finds Barbara Seaforth, a young blind girl, lost in the swamps and takes her home. The two unfortunates fall in love, marry, and have a child. One day, a visiting doctor tells Jerry that Barbara's sight can be restored. The operation is performed successfully, but the doctor warns his patient to shield her eyes from the light or risk reversal of the surgery. Barbara, realizing her husband's dread of exposing his disfigurement to her, looks at her child and then permanently blinds herself by staring into the light, thus sacrificing her sight for the love of her husband.

title: Code Z
description: After an unknown virus invades a co-ed boarding school, a group of high school students must band together and make one last-ditch effort to escape their infection-ridden campus.

title: Panienka z poste restante
description: Three years after the death of his wife, Waldemar still cannot forget her. Lucia is a woman in love with Waldemar, and Bohdan Michorowski is in love with Lucia... but so is Count Brochwicz! The two men come head to head during a New Year`s Eve party, and Waldemar has to step in to avert disaster. Minely trzy lata od smierci ukochanej Waldemara, Stefci. Ordynat nie moze o niej zapomniec. Kocha sie w nim, bez wzajemnosci, Lucia. W niej zas zakochany jest Bohdan Michorowski. O reke Luci stara sie rowniez hrabia Brochwicz. Na balu sylwestrowym dochodzi do scysji pomiedzy Brochwiczem i Bohdanem Michorowskim. Bohdan wyzywa go na pojedynek, ale Waldemar, jako glowa rodziny, korzysta z prawa pierwszenstwa i staje na placu boju zamiast Bohdana. Zwycieza. Lucia i Bohdan postanawiaja sie pobrac, a ordynat mianuje go swoim nastepca. Wykorzystujac powodzenie Tredowatej Henryk Szaro sfilmowal dalszy ciag tej powiesci. Ordynat Michorowski zostal zrealizowany w konwencji dramatu z wyzszych sfer, z elementami sensacji. Prezentuje on przecietny poziom komercyjnych filmow tamtego okresu.

title: Chloe, A to Z
description: When 22-year-old Chloe is left with an unexpected pregnancy after a sexy date, she must face her secret past to move into an uncertain future. Torn between her choices, her friends influence her difficult decision: abortion or adoption.

title: Day Zero
description: During the 22nd Century, science and technology had advanced beyond ethical bounds, so most of mankind reversed course. Eventually, global dictatorships violated the United Nation's Bioethics Treaty, secretly stockpiling arms. As a result, an oblivious America was attacked. Retaliation with augmented nuclear weaponry had unforeseen effects, affecting most survivors in the Western Hemisphere and altering the rest. Those infected became ravenous beasts, feeding off the remaining population. But pockets of humanity remain.

title: Godzilla Minus One [Hindi]
description: Post war Japan is at its lowest point when a new crisis emerges in the form of a giant monster, baptized in the horrific power of the atomic bomb.

title: Zero Hour
description: Set in the isolated trenches of W.W.I, Zero Hour is the tale of a young British Officer confronted with shocking discoveries about his newly assigned Company in Northern France. In his quest for duty and honor, Lieutenant Oliver Enfield decides to set things right by taking matters into his own hands. On the eve of a major offensive, Lieutenant Enfield embarks on an unauthorized reconnaissance mission. title: Zero Zone
description: Zero Zone is film journey to the Ukraine's Eastern front where during late 22' the Ukrainian Armed Forces liberated villages and cites from Russian occupation. The film portrays the reality of a cross section of civilians who survived the Russian occupation and are now faced with rebuilding their lives after having lost everything. In their own words we hear of their experiences, learn from their suffering and come to understand up close the the scars that the Russian occupation left on the lives who have lived through the wholesale destruction of their communities. While at heart the film is reflection on the war by those closest to it, Zero Zone also captures life on the front lines where they daily battle of the war is talking place, across a landscape and in trenches that is more reminiscent of the World War II than anything happening today. Through interview portraits with soldiers, commanders, and civilians we will hear their thoughts on the war and what they must do on a daily basis not only to survive but to fight for the freedom of their homeland.

title: Power of 1
description: Izu Ojukwu's Power of 1 is now available on Amazon Prime Video for viewers in the US and UK. The political thriller, which is partly inspired by 2 Baba's shelved 2017 protests stars Alexx Ekubo in the lead role of Justin Aba, a socially conscious afro-pop artiste with a large following. When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. Nerves are stretched to breaking point as the decision to take ownership and execute the protest throws up intriguing reactions from security operatives, political players, hustlers and opportunists Power of 1 stars Ramsey Nouah, Anne Idibia, Jide Kosoko and Michelle Dede. The film was released in cinemas nationwide last December and has played in theatres in the UK and US.

title: Ficfyon 7
description: The noise of the badly projected cathode ray tube image cleared up and a news program called "Ficfyon 7" appeared on the monitor. Professor Kim Wilson, an expert on the mysterious genre of "Ficfyon" was introduced as a guest, and the host asked him questions about the current state of "Ficfyon." The professor's answer was not in words, but a mysterious gesture. With the presenter's astonished expression, the images on the monitor split and repeat like a matryoshka. Eventually, the program ends as if nothing had happened, but the strange loop continues afterwards.

title: 7½
description: Tunisia, 2011. The transition is abrupt. The country is in full euphoria. From sit-in crowds at Kasbah Square to long queues in front of polling stations, the road to the electoral date is tumultuous. Everyone enjoys the fruits of this historic opportunity in its own way. Everyone is counting on elections to turn a page and write a new one. Multiplying election promises, politicians position themselves and seek to defend their visions. Their supporters invest public space in the conquest of voters. "7½" is a vertiginous dive in a period where Tunisian streets beat with a race for change, a flashback that tickles our memories and our consciences.

title: Dead on Time [Hindi]
description: The 'Arab Spring of 2011' is in full eruption, turmoil consumes the Mid-East region as protesters, rebels and insurgents wreak havoc and destruction. Mike McGuirk (Michael Madsen) sends in a Black-Ops team led by Segar (Michele Ghersi) to securely extract Moshin Dewar (Mohamed Zouaoui) and his newest invention. Moshin sensing something is not right, escapes Segar by jumping out of a flying plane. Using his device to survive, he literally falls into the clutches of a slave mining magnate, Anwar the Butcher (Benbadra Afif), now holding Moshin for trespassing on his land and destroying one of his vehicles. Segar fails in to negotiate with Anwar. McGuirk under extreme pressure from his superiors who fear he is losing control of the situation, switches to Plan B.

title: W817
description: Steve Mertens and Birgit Baukens, a non-stereotypical gay guy and a wannabe career woman, decide to share a house. To cover the rent, they take in three others: Birgit's ex-boyfriend Tom Derijcke, party animal Zoë Zonderland and wicked computer nerd Akke Impens. Complemented by their landlord's hyperactive daughter Jasmijn De Ridder, they soon form a crazy but close group of friends. Later on the series, they are joined by Carlo Stadeus, Akke's best friend, who is physically obsessed by Birgit. Finally, after a switch in house owners, the pedantic teenager Kim De Hert is the last one to force herself into the gang. As the series strolls towards it's conclusion, each of these characters seems to be facing a future they did not expect.

description: 'A Aa E Ee' is a 2009 Telugu-language film directed by Srinivasa Reddy. The film stars Srikanth, Meera Jasmine, and Sadha in lead roles. Chandram (Srikanth) is an honest man and a devoted husband to Kalyani (Meera Jasmine). His life takes a turn when he discovers that pregnant Kalyani is suffering from a rare disease and he must get Rs. 8 lakh for treatment.

title: Come, Embrace Me
description: Preeti lives a wealthy lifestyle in Bombay along with her widower dad, Heerachand, and is a medical student. While on a trip to Simla, she meets and falls in love with a Casanova, Prem, and both get intimate. When her dad opposes this alliance, Prem challenges Heerachand regarding his daughter's love for him. He then leaves Preeti a note, explaining that her father refused the alliance and he was headed to meet his mother, who was urgently sick. Heerachand gets a hold of the letter before Preeti and changes the letter, writing that Prem went away as her father refused to provide any monetary compensation. Years later, both Prem and Preeti are fated to meet again. This time Prem is accompanied by a handicapped young lad, Rahul, while Preeti is about to get engaged to Dr. Amar. Preeti soon realizes that the reason Prem has re-appeared in her life to be near her nubile to-be sister-in-law, Tikki. The question remains what will she do under the circumstances to try and expose Prem as well as protect her past from Dr. Amar? It turns out that Rahul is Prem and Preeti's son and that Prem has come to Dr.Amar for Rahul's treatment. Preeti's father had told her after the birth of the child that she had given birth to a still-born child. After Rahul's operation Preeti comes to know about the reality and confronts her father who confesses to her that he had lied about her giving birth to a dead child and asks her forgiveness but Preeti retorts saying that she an never forgive him as he had lied to her and thinks herself deceived by her own father. Rahul's operation turns to be successful and Preeti and Prem are reunited with their son along with their families.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
description:
"Aa Ab Laut Chalen" is a 1999 Hindi drama film about Rohan, played by Akshaye Khanna, who goes against his family's wishes and moves to the United States in search of a good job. While facing struggles and challenges in a foreign land, he realizes the importance of Indian traditions and values. The film explores whether Rohan will ever return to his family in India or be swayed by the allure of a new life abroad, highlighting themes of family, love, and identity.

title: Ab heute erwachsen
description: The saga of Stefan (David C. Bunners), an 18-year-old construction worker who struggles to make it on his own is the theme that winds its way through this look at growing up. There are surprises in store for the young lad once he manages to move into his own apartment (he had a hard time telling his mother he was moving out). His landlord exploits his good nature to get him to do work around the house and to do favors for his friends too. Stefan's relationship with his mother is already strained after he moved out, and when she discovers how he is being used she really loses it. In an attempt to apologize, she gives Stefan her apartment to watch while she is away for awhile. He opportunistically decides to bring his new girlfriend home overnight, with comic and unforeseen consequences to his relationship with her and his mother.

title: Ab Kya Hoga
description: Ram Sinha comes from a wealthy family. His mother would like him to get married so that their family can have a heir. Ram entrust's this job to his mother, and let's her decide who he should marry. Ram's marriage is arranged with a beautiful young woman named Chitralekha. After the marriage, Ram accuses Chitralekha of being inhuman, a ghost, who is out to kill him. But Chitralekha denies this, and pledges her lifelong love for him. title: Gaddi Jaandi Ae Chalaangaan Maardi [Punjabi]
description: A doomed car is the center of comic situations in this story that follows Ammy Virk, who belongs to a middle-class family of 8. His materialistic father is convinced by him to let him marry the girl of his choice. A small car is given by the girl's family as a dowry, and that pleases the father's greed. Yet, the car breaks when the 8 members of the family try to fit in the 4-seater.

description: Indian immigrant Jai finds friendship and love, upon arriving in London. However one phone call changes everything, thrusting him into a dark and dangerous situation.

Chronicling the trials and tribulations of three young Tamil men. A bright underachiever, the impressionable 23-year old Anpu, who lives with his no-nonsense disciplinarian father. Trapped in a self-perpetuating cycle of isolation, Anpu finds salvation with a local gang. A charismatic gang leader Kumar, who maintains a strong sense of comradely and a code of honour among his members. Gang life is not something he enjoys nor he chose, but circumstances forced him into it and he is waiting for an opportune time to get out. And, far removed from them is an ambitious student Ahilan, who has managed to surmount enormous challenges in life through his positive outlook and determination. They have treaded very different paths in their lives, yet their fates become inexorably tied to each other's. Anpu's involvement in Kumar's gang blossoms into a strong friendship between the two, based on trust and respect. Former classmates and friends, Ahilan and Anpu have grown distant over time due to a girl in their lives. These young men's stories couldn't be more different, yet one thread links them all. All of them are victims of the brutal civil war in Sri Lanka. That fateful bright Saturday starts like any other, and no one could have predicted the chain of events that are about to unfold that will change their lives forever.

After all, according to most mythologies, relationships between mortals and immortals usually leads to mortifying complications, so we're already talking about an extremely mixed blessing. title: A Light Sleep
description:
Sixteen-year-old Yeo Lin used to have a boyfriend and normal life, but everything changed when she lost both her parents two years ago. To support her siblings, she sells her body. Quietly bearing wounds and responsibilities beyond her age, she faces the cruel trials of love, friendship, and premature adulthood, and she does it all in seeming detachment. Always tired, Yeo Lin suffers from chronic insomnia and relies on medication to sleep. For Yeo Lin, sleep is an escape that she wakes from too soon.

title: Zheng qing kuang ai
description: Two girls of disparate class backgrounds suffer through teenage rebellion, drug abuse, and prostitution in cutting-edge Taipei.

title: AI Amok
description: Artificial Intelligence has permeated every aspect of planetary life in 2030. Tokyoites experience AI in every aspect of their lives whether medical, finance, transportation or their personal and day-to-day interactions. Many would tell you that AI is indispensable. Yet, as is often the case with technology jumping the gun on ethics and rules AI spins out of control and causes calamity after calamity. The city and the country are in chaos.

title: The Gene of AI
description: A doctor who treats robot and humanoid problems takes place in the near future when humanoids with AI account for 10% of the population. Hikaru Sudô, also known as Moggadeet, secretly takes on illegal medical procedures.

title: Ai wo tsumu hito
description: Atsushi was a dedicated and serious worker for all of his adult life. Now retired to the northern territory of Hokkaido with his wife Ryoko, Atsushi is at a loss with what to do with all the time on his hands. As Atsushi busies himself with erecting a stone gate to surround their new home, a local lad is recruited to help, the couple's reconciling daughter comes to visit and Ryoko holds a secret close to her bosom.

title: Ai no uta
description: A drama about a man and woman who come to know true love after unexpected circumstances cause them to live under the same roof. Singer and songwriter Tamaki Koji returns to acting after a 8 year hiatus, to star opposite Kanno Miho in this drama. Koji plays a very kind policeman; a champion of the weak and a pacifist. Having lost his wife 4 years earlier, he has been saddled with the arduous task of raising 3 children single-handedly. Kanno stars as the unfortunate heroine with an ugly personality who grows through her encounters with this good natured middle aged man.

title: Ima ai ni yukimasu
description: Yuuji is still a first-grade student, he is having a very hard time understanding what has happened to his mother and the fact that she won't be coming back. At the very beginning , the voice of the late mother is reading from a picture book that she wrote for Yuuji before she died. It is about a mother who dies, but promises to return when the rainy season comes. Yuuji believes in this story and thinks that his mother will come back when the rainy season comes. And surprisingly - she actually does. When it begins raining on a June morning, Yuuji runs out into the forest to the special place where he used to play with his mother. His father, Takumi chases after him to get him to go to school. When they arrive at the old ruined building where they used to play, Yuuji's mother, Mio is waiting there completely alive and healthy, but she has no memory of them or anything that occurred during her life.

title: Ai Ai
description: Zainab 's father dead body is mistaken for the body of a high minister which is planed to march through a public parade. Comparison between the life and death of the poor and the rich and powerful is made in a comic way.

title: Zhen ai 100 tian
description: When a cold hearted telecommunications executive returns to his small island town for his estranged mother's burial, he learns about the true Taiwanese tradition that mandates him to marry within 100 days so that the parent's spirit can transition peacefully. When a typhoon leaves him stranded for 3 days, he rekindles romance with his free spirited, childhood sweetheart who is engaged to marry a local villager/step brother.

title: Ai Que Vida!
description: Cleonice decides to run for mayor while his son, Valdir, pays his respects to a philanthropic institution and ends up falling in love with a girl. In the fictional Poço Fundo, politics and affection mingle in saga against corruption.

title: Vacanze ai Caraibi
description: Three comedic and intertwined episodes.

title: AI Dungeon
description: Simon, Lewis and friends play AI Dungeon, a role playing game in which you can type anything and the AI will guide you on a crazy adventure.

title: Ai no kotodama
description: Ootani and Tachibana have been inseparable since high school. Now that they're in college, they live together, they're happy and everything seems prefect. But their little world is disrupted when they meet an old high school friend, Yuki, who seems to have a crush on Tachibana, making Ootani feel jealous and insecure. Will Tachibana really choose him over a pretty girl?

title: Wo ai hu li jing
description: A restless husband attempts his first love affair with Nancy, a lively and vivacious girl. Hooked, he transforms his wife into another Nancy and the three live happily ever after or so it may seem.

title: Ai no kudaranai
description: Kei Tamai, an assistant producer at a regional TV station, is trying to have a baby with her live-in boyfriend Yoshi. He says he'll marry her once she gets pregnant, having given up his dream of making it big as a comedian, and frequently skips work, which has gradually cooled Kei's feelings for him. She secretly takes contraceptives, and devotes herself to her job. One day, Kei's irritation with the whining Yoshi reaches a peak, and she starts to walk out on him. In desperation, he tries to stop her by dropping a bombshell: "I'm pregnant, so let's get married." As Kei's career and relationship go off the rails, she is forced to confront her own obliviousness.

title: Ai cao
description: A woman who believes she chose an unconventional path in her life is startled to find her children are stepping farther beyond society's boundaries in this drama from Taiwanese filmmaker Hsiu-Chiung Chiang. Ai-tsao (Li-li Pan) is a widow who is nearly 60 years old; her husband, over twenty years her senior, has been dead for nearly two decades, and Ai-tsao's life has settled into a comfortable routine of looking after her elderly mother and doting on her two adult children. Ai-tsao had a strong independent streak when she was young and struck out on her own over the objections of her parents, but she's not quite as willing to accept that her children have chosen lives different from her own. Ai-tsao slowly comes to the realization that her son is gay and struggles to come to terms with his lifestyle, but it's even more difficult for Ai-tsao when she discovers her daughter is going to be the unwed mother of a mixed-race child.

At present he is the Minister of Health and Welfare, and is considering submission of a Bill to hold population increase in check, in an attempt to easily deal with Opposition accusations regarding the population problem. To make matters worse, he finds out that his eldest son, Jotaro, had been secretly having an affair with his own secretary, Saeko Godai, and it seems that she is also expecting a little 'Burden of Love.' Also, the Araki family's young daughter, Sakura, has become pregnant with her fiancé before their upcoming marriage, and even the retired patron of the family, Jozo, 2 presents yet another possibility of a pregnancy with his much younger mistress. Furthermore, Jozaburo visits Kyoto on an election campaign and is astounded to learn of the existence of his own love-child with his former lover, Some Kaida! title: Ahlam Al Fata Al Taeer
description: The series revolves around Ibrahim Al Taeer's release from prison and his return to his usual theft activity. He performs a huge operation to smuggle 750,000 pounds, and hides with the smuggled money in a mental hospital in agreement with the hospital director alone with nobody else knowing. He kills the director of the hospital, then flees with another patient to escape from the police and the gang who wants the smuggled money.

title: Gaana Al-Bayan Al-Taly
description: Nader Seif Al-Din dreams of becoming a TV presenter for The Truth channel, but as he doesn't have any connections, he and his colleague Effat Al-Sherbiny are rejected. When they start working as news editors, they learn confidential information about Riad Ghanem's dairy factories.

title: Al Sada Al Afadel
description: After their father's death, the Abu AL-Fadl family faces debts and chaos. Brothers Tarek and Hejazi try to fix things, but a mysterious man's demands turn their efforts into disaster.

title: Al Theeb Fi Al Qaleeb
description: In a comic framework, an accountant is accused of embezzlement and finds himself forced to facing his family members 'contradictory positions on the case while trying to prove his innocence.

title: Akher Al Rejal Al Mohtaramen
description: A Teacher in Upper Egypt is assigned to supervise a students' trip to Cairo as the trip doesn't go as planned, he has to find a way to make things right, but things get complicated and run against his moral values.

title: Al Bawabat Al Sabaa'
description: Al Bawabat Al Sabaa'

title: Kheit al rafeigh, -al
description: (Mona) A poor girl who works as a simple employee at a bank and provides her family. Under the pressure of need and illness of her father and the pressure of her mother, which insists on her to increase her income, she gets a wealthy old businessman to love her. An engineer (Adel), who works in the company of her lover (Abdo) reveals his love, she convinces him to resign and build his own independent company and give him jewelry as a capital and stand by him and encourage him and cut ties with (Abdo). Will their love story continue?

title: Al faris wa al chaki
description: Essam is a young man from a wealthy aristocratic family who falls in love with the poor girl Amal. He takes her to his family's home, but the family does not welcome her. Amal's past comes back to haunt her.

title: Ala Al-Donia Al-Salam
description: The events revolve around the two (Mahzooza) and (Mabrooka) sisters with their uncle, because of their claim to their right to inherit from their father. Their uncle accuses them of insanity and admits them to a psychiatric hospital.

title: Al Ragol Al Akhtar
description: Omar returns to Egypt after 28 years to take back his father's building which was seized by those who rented its apartments. When he fails to convince the owners of the bank that occupies the ground floor to leave, he decides to rob the bank.

title: Al Iiftar Al Akhir
description: The love story of a married couple separated by death after the wife died while they were having breakfast. Their love and the details the husband holds about her remain in his memory full of events. While a strong desire to catch up with his wife arises within him, he meets a person full of energy who gives him a new perspective on life.

title: Al eeteraf al akhir
description: Adham a faithful husband still mourning his deceased wife,visited one night by a woman in white revealing her secret love for him since college,and his wife true acts behind his back,but the big revelation was this woman is no longer from the living and its her ghost that paid him a visit.

title: Al Sadah Al Rejal
description: A Man and his wife who are always in conflict their life changes up side down when the wife decided to become a male though a surgery.

title: Abbas al abiad fi al yawm al aswad
description: Abbas Al-Abyad is a teacher who traveled to Iraq in search of money, and when he returned, he discovered that he was not alive in the eyes of his family, after missing for years he spent in a prison there.

title: Al lo'ba Al Qazera
description: An honest lawyer who only defends the innocent faces an ethical dilemma when his daughter's boss, a businessman and a smuggler, gets in trouble with the law and wants him and his other daughter, who doesn't share her father's views, to be his lawyers.

title: Al-Amira & Al-Nahar
description: Princess Olmina must complete 3 tasks to become queen: swim the Tigris, cross the desert, and climb Mount Zagros. She fails the last task, but learns the importance of family and teamwork.

title: Al Tawarid
description: The leader of the Tawarid tribe, finds two infants, Khalaf and Mahawish, and orders for the women to breastfeed and look after them. The two become milk-brothers to almost all of the tribe's girls, except for Wadha.

title: Salah Al-deen Al-Ayyobi
description: A Syrian series about the crusades and the Muslim leader Saladin and his conquest of Jerusalem.

title: Al Hay Al Khalfi
description: The story revolves around a poor family living in a marginalized neighborhood in the city of Casablanca. The father is a gambling addict, the mother is an elderly woman, and the children face various conditions.

title: Al-mufattish al-amm
description: When a penniless fertilizer inspector visits a village, its mayor mistakes him for an Inspector General sent to investigate charges of corruption.

title: Al Hesla Al Aela 007
description: Al Hesla Al Aela 007

title: Al-Hob Wa Al-Salam
description: The events of the series alternate between two periods of time, the first during the first Gulf War, and the second in a state of siege during the era of the Baath regime

title: Al Dahik Al Baki
description: The events depict the story of the famous actor Naguib El Rehany since childhood and highlight the human and social aspects of his life, as well as the political events he witnessed, especially the 1919 Revolution, the First and Second World Wars, the Constitution of 1923, and the British occupation of Egypt.

title: Al-Qamar Akher Al-Dunya
description: As Dalal returns from abroad with her husband Khaled, she is surprised to learn that her mother, Karima, has disappeared, leaving Dalal to looks for her with her brothers Galal and Ahmed. Ahmed.

title: Al Espacio!
description: After many months through The Great Lockdown in Mexico City, Osvaldo builds up a spaceship but nothing happens as planned.

title: Al Ashash
description: Sayed is falsely accused of a murder crime and must follow the man who witnessed against him across the country in order to prove his innocence.

title: Al Nehaya
description: In 2120, A Software engineer attempts to face the dangerous technology that took control over the world 50 years from now, starting from teaching a bunch of kids how this whole thing started, but everything changes when he meets the artificial clone of himself.

title: Sayedat al akmar al sawdaa
description: In the depths of loneliness and despair, beautiful Aida visits her "tailor," Victoria, a woman who runs a sensual house where erotic fantasies are fulfilled. After satisfying her desires in the arms of one of Victoria's young men, Aida has a haunting nightmare where she envisions herself as a witch who, during a full moon, has the power to destroy her lovers' sensitivity. This disturbing dream sends Aida into a downward spiral of self-destruction. When Aida finally loses her will to live and all hope for salvation, she longs to purify herself and find forgiveness for her sins. Reminiscent of Stanley Kubrick's Eyes Wide Shut and the stylishly erotic films of Radley Metzger, The Lady of the Black Moons emerged from an era of relaxed censorship in Egypt.

title: Al khorba
description: The life in a Syrian village with the daily issues of its simple minded poor inhabitants and the continuous conflict between two families for control and recognition

title: Al Marut
description: The story of a poor woman from the Al-Bataween neighborhood in Baghdad, as she gets exposed to great injustice and decides to gather her strength to help and support the youth.

title: Al-ayyam al-tawila
description: In 1959 underground revolutionaries try to assassinate Prime Minister Abd al-Karim Kassem in Baghdad. News reports claim they have failed, and at first the revolutionaries lay low, but as the secret police continue to comb the neighborhoods with house-to-house searches, they flee to the countryside. Among those fleeing is Saddam Hussein, the future president of the republic.

title: Am Sgula
description: Am Sgula is an Israeli comedy show that aired on Keshet's Channel 2 in 2011, starring members of the Ma Kashur trio - actors Tzion Baruch , Asi Israelof and Shalom Michaelshwilli. The program comically presents various Israelis who come abroad or are related to traveling around the world. Some of the episodes were filmed in India and Thailand.

title: I Am Nobody S1-S2

title: Am Dro!
description: In this brand new popular format, four lovers of the countryside battle it out to have their favourite Welsh walking trail immortalised in the S4C walk of fame.

title: I Am Samuel
description: Filmed verite style over five years, I Am Samuel is an intimate portrait of a Kenyan man torn between balancing duty to his family with his dreams for his future.

title: What Am I
description: 'What Am I' is a film about a man who after a string of heart breaks and failed relationships decides he will shut himself off emotionally from women. To fill the void, however, that being in a relationship fulfills, he decides to become a photographer of women, adapting an alter ego, a project hidden from his family and friends. But one of his biggest fans soon complicates his world when she joins him on a few shoots, and he finds that he must ultimately choose who exactly he wants to be, lest the decision is made for him.

title: I Am Human
description: Meet the world's first 'cyborgs' - a quadriplegic, a blind man, an amputee, a bio-hacker, and a woman with Parkinson's - the scientists who help them, and one entrepreneur who will stop at nothing on his quest to unlock the brain.

title: Why I Am
description: This film is the first of 5 movies based on true events about an upper-class young man who becomes a heavy criminal after the loss of his mom's high-paying job due to layoffs and his father having to work three jobs and having to move back to the ghetto. He decided to pay his own way no matter what the cost.

title: 8:28 am
description: A married woman runs a successful gallery and falls for a man she met accidentally.

title: I Am Vengeance
description: A schizophrenic teenage girl attempts to uncover her mysterious path and the murder of her family.

title: Main Hoon Na
description: An army major goes undercover as a college student. His mission is both professional and personal: to protect his general's daughter from a radical militant, and to find his estranged half-brother.

title: 10 am
description: '10 AM' is a story of the new Indian youth. Where financial freedom is now accompanied by huge self-denials, dramatic lifestyle changes and value system challenges. Which at times is leading to loss of identity. 10 am portrays poignantly the anguish and pain of the new Indian youth caught in a Catch 22 situation. The story is a stark exposition of the social decadence that has set in, into every facet of our day to day to life. The degradation of moral values. The diffusion of human ethos. And finally, cultural atrophy of our psyche is deftly handed in this excellently crafted story. It's the story of a currently on bench (in between jobs situation in software industry) young man, when a sudden crisis puts his well-off family into a financial mess.

title: I Am Aroused
description: There is a girl who is a student at a tailoring school. She has a friend who has a boyfriend and is always having sex. She herself, however, remains a virgin. She sees her brother masturbating one day. She asks her friend to have sex with her brother. Her friend asks her to spread it for her older brother in exchange. It is a deal and the four go on a hike.

title: Berlin am Meer
description: They are students - at least that's what their parents think - they are the disc-jockeys in the in-clubs in town, they party with no end, they fall in love, they have the best summer in their life in the coolest city of the world: Berlin.

title: I Am David
description: A twelve-year-old boy escapes from a Bulgarian Communist concentration camp and sets out on a journey to reach Denmark.

title: I Am Teppei!
description: Teppei, brought up by his father in the mountains, is an energetic boy who is as tough as weeds and acts as free as a bird. His life changes completely when he enrolls in high school, the first school he has ever attended. Despite his eccentric behavior and being a constant source of troubles, he is soon recognized for his talent in sports-especially in Kendo (the Japanese swordplay art)-and becomes the school's hero.

title: Who Am I
description: Based on the critically acclaimed novel KO aham By AshokJamnani, The story is set in a small town based on the banks of the river Narmada. Bhavitavya, a philosophy student who is currently living as a tenant at Jyoti's house, is also his girlfriend Aditi's mother. Though the two love each other, their way of life has always differed. While Bhavitva is a curious fellow filled with philosophical questions, Aditi is a cheerful girl who finds joy in even the little things in life. The story takes a turn when Bhavitavya's favourite philosophy professor, Vibhu Laxmi Narayan passes away. The turbulent mind of Bhavitavya starts questioning the existential questions of life. The questions like "Who am I?" or "Ko Aham?" heighten and soon his interaction with an old monk on Narmada Ghat compelled him to embark on a journey of self-discovery Narmada parikrama in the hope to find the answers to his many questions.

title: Am o idee
description: Some party representatives want to make a new football team. It is supposed to be a comedy.

title: I Am Bone
description: After a gifted boy from 16th Street in Santa Monica is violated by a corrupt police officer and swallowed by the streets, he grows into a feared gang leader known as Bone.

title: I am Going
description: The idea for the film I Am Going originated on the streets of Paris and at the Cité internationale des arts. A narrative in black and white whose protagonists stand facing one another to proclaim nothing less than the end of the world. Two women gifted with political acumen and common sense, whose interpretations go unheard nevertheless. Their revelations are articulated on a sort of pilgrimage that leads each of them to find the other. The journey takes them from the country to the city, from the city back to the country and directly through the city itself. It is the pose, the gesture in public space, like a raised fist, a scarf held in a hand, or public graffiti, that weighs on the characters' shoulders and grows heavier by going unnoticed.

title: I Am Banni
description: "I Am Banni" is a Hindi feature film Produced by Mr. Anil Garg along with Rahul and Gaurav Garg of RG Movies production and Directed by Nitin Chaudhary and K.K. Makwana. Promoting the social cause "Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao", I am Banni features Actress Roshni Walia, Gaurav Garg, Harjinder Singh, Amanda Rodario and Vikas Shrivastav in the lead role. Shot in Bhuj and across the grandeur of the Rann of Kutch, "I am Banni" highlights the struggles of a young girl who wants to study and also enables other girls of her conservative village to be allowed to study. The movie aims at educating the audience that even in 2018 there is an appalling amount of girls who are not allowed to study due to the archaic rules of our society.

title: Draußen am See
description: Jessika, a precocious teenage girl with loving parents and a good-natured older sister, is the center of a slightly eccentric family. A series of small events disrupts their delicately balanced ecosystem. Jessika's father loses his job and becomes bored and despondent, while Jessika's mother reenters the workforce and becomes empowered. These events act as catalysts for the slow, painful disintegration of the family, with each member committing shocking acts of alienation and self-destruction. Desperately wanting her family but at the same time desiring her adolescent independence, Jessika struggles to find the best way to restore a balance.

title: Who Am I
description: In one apartment, nine human conditions experience a contained life as they make the world their own.

title: Mississippi I Am
description: In 2006, 'NSync's Lance Bass came out publicly as gay. Once the "most beloved son" of his home state of Mississippi, he was instantly rejected and his hopes that Mississippi could ever embrace change were dashed. Then in 2010 he heard the story of Constance McMillen, 18, who was suing her school for denying her the right to go to the prom with her girlfriend. Something was shifting even in the most socially conservative states in America. MISSISSIPPI: I AM, examines the relatively new battle on the part of primarily young LGBT people to bring gay civil rights and visibility out in the open and beyond division.

title: Am fost 16
description: The heroic march of the Romanian Army to conquer Budapest once more. Everybody is saved and treated well by the Romanians.

title: I Am Nezha
description: The film genre fiction is inspired by character fairy-tale NeZha.

title: I Am Khama!
description: The real BLACK PANTHER. It is 1895. A brilliant African King, whose country is about to be stolen, rushes to England, tours the country, wins the people to his side, blackmails the Colonial Minister and confronts Queen Victoria at Windsor.

title: I Am Thalente
description: Homeless since the age of nine, South African skateboarder Thalente Biyela travels to the US to pursue his dream of becoming a professional skateboarder. Through his eyes, we experience what it takes to rise up out of circumstance and escape a lifetime on the streets.

title: I Am Kathalan
description: A college student decides to hack into the security system of a company owned by his ex-girlfriend's father.

title: I am Sam
description: There are some offers that you just can't refuse. Jang Yi San (Yang Dong Geun) is a rookie teacher who is put in charge of a homeroom full of misfits and troublemakers, including Chae Moo Shin (T.O.P) and Yoo Eun Byul (Park Min Young). Eun Byul happens to be the daughter of Yoo Jae Gon (Park Joon Gyu), the head of a dangerous gangster organization. title: I Am Nasrine
description: When you change where you are do you change who you are? I Am Nasrine is an intimate journey of self-discovery and ultimately reveals the unfolding of a soul. Set in modern day Tehran, and the UK, the film follows the paths of Nasrine and Ali, sister and brother in a comfortable, middle class Iranian home. When Nasrine has a run-in with the police, the punishment is more than she bargained for. At her father's bidding, Nasrine and Ali set out for the UK, torn about leaving behind their home and all that they know, embarking on a reluctant exile. Still, for Nasrine, there is undeniable excitement about the prospect of starting a new life in the West, and an eagerness for its promise of new freedoms. Arriving in Britain, their fate and their future are far from certain. Nasrine is quick to settle into her new life, making friends, forming bonds, including Nichole from the gypsy/travelers community. All the while her brother Ali struggles with the realities of life in the UK and his awakening sexuality. Then comes 9/11. Their parents will be unable to join them in Britain, leaving them quite alone. Things spiral further out of control when an unimaginable tragedy occurs. Nasrine must discover an incredible courage within her to accept what fate has dealt her; discovering that the end of her journey is really just the beginning. Can hope, simple untainted hope, overcome the darkest of tragedies? I Am Nasrine explores these questions and more, and offers answers that are sure to surprise.

title: I Am Nevenka
description: Centers on true happenings of Nevenka Fernández, a young woman in 1990s Spain who courageously reported sexual harassment by her employer. Her tenacity pioneered the fight against workplace misconduct in her country.

title: I Am Not
description: A touching and humorous film about loss, life chances, love, family, illness, the end and the beginning. It is also about the search for roots and the therapeutic role of cinema, which can be an escape or create new worlds. This bittersweet family story is abundantly saturated with emotions, although its main character has serious difficulty with showing it. Oren was diagnosed with Asperger syndrome and the fact that he is an adopted child makes it difficult for him to adapt. Suddenly, his life changes with the help of the camera, which becomes an extraordinary therapy tool assisting him on a long journey in search of his identity.

title: Am Rand der Hoffnung
description: In summer 2005 Israel withdraws from the Gaza-strip. While the world has its eyes fixed on the small area on the Mediterranean, life goes on in its own absurd way in the Westbank. The focus is on a 35 year old Palestinian named Ramadan, who is living in Qalandia refugee-camp, even though he has a good job: He is camera-operator for Al-Jazeera at the Ramallah office of the well-known Arabian network. The camera gives him the feeling of producing something meaningful while his homeland is caught in daily absurdities. "Daily life has a completely different meaning in Palestine. Commented by Ramadan the film delivers insight into a life under occupation. It's a life running in circles with hope for better times but no belief that these will come - it's the edge of hope.

title: I Am Toxic [Hindi]
description: Year 2101. The southern hemisphere of planet Earth has become the world's garbage dump. In the middle of this enormous cemetery, a man will wake up without remembering anything about his past, his present or why he is there.

title: I Am No Bird
description: Four brides. Four countries. One big day. Women spend their lives receiving contradictory messages about marriage: an aspiration, a fantasy, a trap. An ancient institution, whose meaning has been fiercely debated the world over, it can be difficult to pin-point what marriage means to modern women around the world. To Benay, in Turkey, it means a new beginning and a new family, something she lost with the passing of her mother when she was a child. To honour this, she's getting married on Mother's Day. To Anna, in Australia, it means being made one with her partner and her God, and preparing to lose her virginity. To Luthanlu, in India, it means an opportunity to continue her Rongmei Naga culture, a tribal minority in the North-East of the country. And to Dalia, in Mexico, it means the validation of her relationship with her girlfriend, and hopefully, reconciliation with her conservative mother.

description: An American Ascent documents the first African American expedition to tackle Denali, North America's highest peak and explores the complex relationship many African-Americans have with the outdoors. As the United States transitions to a 'minority majority' nation, a staggering number of people of color do not identify with America's wild places. By embarking on the grueling multi-week climb of the 20,327ft Denali, nine African-American climbers set out to bridge this 'adventure gap' - challenging outdated notions of what adventure looks like by changing the face of America's biggest and baddest mountain on the 100th anniversary of its first summit.

title: An Armenian Journey

title: An Extinction
description:
It starts with an extensively drug resistant strain of TB in Western Australia, and total extinction of all human, animal, plant, and bacterial life on the planet. Only the birds remain. The birds, and a few bedraggled and starving survivors. Some are the lucky ones who survived their infection. Others are the resourceful ones who managed to avoid the airborne Red11 infection altogether.

Aoife and Niamh are two of the latter, sisters who live on in post-apocalyptic Ireland, having avoided the disease altogether through reclusiveness, caution, and luck. They spend their days trawling the Irish countryside for anything that will help keep them alive, staying one foot ahead of starvation and infection, not daring to approach the lawless anarchy of the big towns and cities that are left. At night they retreat to their base, a small house deep in the wilderness, where they read, play board games, and remember the past.

Their routine is turned upside down when they encounter an intruder, a desperate loner trying to outrun a group he calls 'The Lost Boys'. Knowing the danger he poses them as the only other person who knows the location of their house, the girls cannot let him go. They consider what they should do with him in grim conversation, and end up holding him as a prisoner. He speaks of a rumored town out west near Galway, the town of New Hope, where people have come together and civilization has started again. When The Lost Boys catch up with them the girls are forced to flee their last refuge and take off on a desperate and deadly journey across the barren country in the pursuit of New Hope...

title: An Orphan's Dream
description: This is the incredible story of two orphans who were given a chance to dream... Durga, born in an impoverished village in Nepal, was orphaned at 10 years old - becoming Mom and Dad to her younger brother. She sent him to school while she worked at a gravel pit - chipping rocks. After being rescued by a Canadian NGO, Durga was given her first chance to go to school. Today she is 20 years old and graduating as a certified accountant. She is introduced to photographer Samantha Walker, who documents her life in photography - expressing the pain of the past to the hope of the present and future. After losing his family in the rebel wars in Liberia, Africa, Philip struggled through a series of UNBELIEVABLE events. Yet he seized opportunities that led him to become a top student at the University of Johannesburg. His encounter with singer-songwriter Andrew Smith is filled with emotion. Smith will write an instrumental song about Philip's experiences - while they journey back into his childhood of terror.

title: An Addicting Picture

title: Just an Acquaintance

One day, he saved a lady who was CEO of a big cosmetic company by accident. He expected her of something good one in return. But she just gave him some cards of baseball players. He disappointed so much. But these cards were value if they were complete. He missed 3 cards which were the most valuable. If he had 1,000,000 yen, he could get these 3 cards, and he could sell all cards by 5,000,000 yen. And he found strange job that was good for his situation. It was that staying in closed beach house with 2 other strangers for 2 weeks.

title: An Accidental Fire
description: Set in present-day in the historic city of Philadelphia and inspired by real-life recent events, the premise of An Accidental Fire is a microcosm for our world's increasing societal discord. An Accidental Fire follows the story of an unlikely trio of heroes through their daring escape from a recommissioned prison. It follows them down the rabbit hole into which they they find themselves falling. Simultaneously, AAF tells the tale of a group of treacherous villains who pose as much of a danger to each other as they do to the heroes. Troy Hudson Jr., a hopeful and idealistic schoolteacher, is arrested while leading a protest and taken to a recommissioned prison facility. He quickly learns an unimaginable truth: he has only three days to escape before he and the other detainees are to be disappeared forever. A covert operative, Helen, goes on a personal mission to help Troy escape. With the help of her covert group, The Shadows, she connects with the stoic Officer William Ridley to help Troy and the imprisoned children to escape. Enter the villains, the sociopathic Captain Erin Clark, her submissive minion Officer Dennis Chandler, and Government One Intelligence Agent Darius Whitaker. Following the heroes' prison escape, a manhunt ensues. While Troy, Helen, and Ridley, work to stay hidden, they begin to uncover not just Captain Clark's secrets - including her past connection with Troy and his family - but also, they begin to crack the shell of secrets that surround Agent Darius Whitaker and the secret global cabal that employs him, Government One (G-1). Working together, the ensemble races against the clock to expose the secrets of devious, manipulative Captain Clark to show the world who she really is and to escape the lethal hunters set on them by G-1 before it's too late for them, and for the world as they know it.

title: An Occasional Friend
description: Lies.. Deceit.. Deadly Secrets.. even Murder?. This twisted combination may prove fatal for some and could reveal the terrible truth, that even friendships are never forever.

title: An American Abroad
description: Marcia Kimpton lives her dream as a globe-trotting TV host, teaming with comedians to explore each new city she visits. But mixing work and romance at middle-age brings unforeseen challenges and rewards.

title: An Innocent Kiss
description: Elbow Grease is a sincere look into the humor and craziness that is the everyday life of the Barnes family as they come to terms with each other. Billy and Ellie's marriage may be on the rocks, but they don't know chaos until Billy's wayward brother arrives and spreads it not only through the family but to the neighbors and the entire town of Guppie, South Carolina as it prepares for its annual festival.

title: An Unhealthy Obsession
description: College student Nico suffers from ADHD and has no interest in interacting with new people. The new kid has peaked his interest. Upon ditching his best friend at a party, he will find why it's suspicious no one seems to know who this new kid is.

title: Dhindora [Hindi]
description: It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead [Hindi]
description: Kimizuka Kimihiko is a crisis-magnet. From getting caught up in a crime scene to accidentally witnessing a drug deal, trouble seems to find him around every corner. So it is no surprise when his rather mundane flight suddenly enters a state of emergency with a dire need of a detective onboard. Unfortunately, his attempt at avoiding trouble is foiled by a beautiful girl with silver hair who goes by the codename Siesta. Declaring herself a detective, she unceremoniously drags Kimizuka into the case as her assistant. That incident spelled the beginning of an adventure around the globe that went beyond his wildest imagination. Putting their lives on the line, the two took down criminal organizations, prevented disasters, and saved thousands. But the curtain closed to their epic journey with Siesta's untimely death three years later. Resolving to live an ordinary high school life this time, Kimizuka spends a year maintaining a low profile. However, as fate would have it, a girl with an uncanny resemblance to Siesta comes crashing into his life, threatening to throw his peaceful days into disarray.

title: Scientific Thinking
description:
In 7 episodes, Crash Course Scientific Thinking will teach learners the foundational principles underlying scientific thought, pulling back the curtain on processes like peer review, interrogating what makes sources reliable (or not), unpacking how consensus is reached, and revealing how scientific understanding changes over time. Ultimately, learners will gain the ability to think more critically about the scientific information they encounter in their everyday lives. 

Series Objectives
- Describe the dynamic, communal nature of science, articulating the roles of uncertainty and consensus.
- Explain the role of peer review and replication in science.
- Unpack the potential for bias and error in science and understand its self-correction mechanisms.
- Understand the role of specialization in scientific expertise.
- Interpret primary, secondary, and tertiary sources, and use lateral reading to verify claims.
- Understand basic statistical language used to describe scientific findings.

title: English for Career Development
description:
Welcome to English for Career Development, a course created by the University of Pennsylvania, and funded by the U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, Office of English Language Programs. 
To enroll in this course for free, click on “Enroll now” and then select "Full Course. No certificate."
This course is designed for non-native English speakers who are interested in advancing their careers in the global marketplace. In this course, you will learn about the job search, application, and interview process in the United States, while comparing and contrasting the same process in your home country. This course will also give you the opportunity to explore your global career path, while building your vocabulary and improving your language skills to achieve your professional goals. The first unit in this course will introduce the U.S. job application process and provide strategies for identifying the jobs that match your interests and skills. Unit 2 will take you through the steps necessary to produce a professional-looking resume. In unit 3, you will work to develop a clear and concise cover letter. The final unit of the course focuses on networking and interview skills.
Anyone may take this course for free. If you want to get a Coursera Verified Certificate for free, please fill out the Financial Aid form.
 Unless otherwise noted, all course materials are available for re-use, repurposing and free distribution under a Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution license.
Supplemental reading materials were provided by Newsela, which publishes daily news articles at a level that's just right for each English language learner.

title: Programming with JavaScript
description: JavaScript is the programming language that powers the modern web. In this course, you will learn the basic concepts of web development with JavaScript. You will work with functions, objects, arrays, variables, data types, the HTML DOM, and much more. You will learn how to use JavaScript and discover interactive possibilities with modern JavaScript technologies. Finally, you will learn about the practice of testing code and how to write a unit test using Jest.

title: Business English: Capstone Project
description:
The capstone project will give you opportunities to demonstrate your competence in the learning objectives for this Specialization. For the project, you’ll use formal, written methods and more casual visual and audio methods of communication to demonstrate your ability to use language appropriate for different business contexts. The goal of this course is to demonstrate competence in writing and presenting a plan using skills and language appropriate for business.
Course Learning Objectives
•	Use appropriate vocabulary to write a mini business plan
•	Communicate a business plan orally in an organized and engaging presentation

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

title: The Rising Son - From Shame to Supremacy
description: Micro Drama

title: Sauda Pyaar Ka
description: Sauda Pyaar Ka is an emotional romance where a humble tailor secretly lives a double life as India's biggest fashion tycoon. While he sacrifices everything for the woman he loves, she betrays him for wealth and status—only to discover his true identity when it's too late. A story of love, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption.

title: My PA is a Political Prince
description:
My PA Is a Political Prince

Fearless activist Riya dreams of changing the world, unaware that her unpaid PA, Aryaman, is actually the heir to a powerful political dynasty. As love grows between them, ambitious politician Vikram pulls Riya into a dangerous world of fame and power. Torn between love and ambition, Riya must discover who truly stands by her before she loses everything.

title: Mere Papa Heeralal
description: When a self-made billionaire CEO is forced to fake a marriage with a poor lift mechanic to protect her son and save her empire, neither of them realizes that they are actually reunited lovers, the child's real parents, and heirs to a secret that will shake Mumbai's most powerful families.

title: Cruel Attraction
description: After being framed and imprisoned for a crime she didn't commit, Chandni returns home determined to find her missing younger sister. Forced into a dangerous deal with the notorious playboy Luv Rathore, she agrees to seduce his golden-boy brother Kush as part of a revenge scheme. But as buried secrets surface, Chandni discovers that one brother may be the villain everyone loves—and the other may be the devil willing to save her.

title: The Gangster King
description: Veer is secretly a super powerful  and influential man controlling pokiticians and business men, while he pretends to be a cleaner - and ends up in a contract marriage with a businesswoman, whom he protects and gradually falls for. This businesswoman, Tara, faces problems created by her own family members along with a powerful and dangerous man - but Veer is too powerful and influential for all of them. He overpowers all the problems, while hiding his reality all this time.

title: Super Dad Sunil Tyagi
description: A scrap dealer secretly living as a billionaire tests his daughter’s strength and love. When her rich fiancé betrays and humiliates them, the truth is revealed—bringing justice, redemption, and proving that real wealth is character, not money.

title: Khoon Ka Rishta [Hindi]
description: When blind but brilliant photographer Zoya crosses paths with brooding businessman Yug Singhania, sparks fly in unexpected ways. As love blossoms through secrets, emotional wounds, and societal barriers, Zoya becomes Yug’s guiding light and he becomes her strength. Together, they discover that true vision comes not from the eyes, but from the heart.

title: The Triple Crown
description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

title: Ajnabi Rishta
description:
Baby Loading Pyaar Pending is an engaging story of a pregnant college student, who fights stigma, poverty, and heartbreak while hiding a marriage born of sacrifice.
A powerful CEO unknowingly crosses paths with the wife he once rejected. Fate forces truth, redemption, and love to reunite a broken family. Watch now.

title: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose [Hindi]
description: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose

title: Ajnabi ka Intezar Hai
description: A broken woman, robbed of motherhood, finds unexpected love in a humble construction worker—unaware he’s a secret billionaire hiding his true identity. As their fragile romance deepens, dark secrets, betrayal, and a stolen child resurface, forcing them to fight against fate, enemies, and shattered trust to claim the family they were destined for.

title: Love Gamble
description: Love Gamble is a drama mini-series that follows the unlikely connection between a wealthy nightclub owner and a struggling young woman. The story begins when Litika, a homeless woman, rescues an expensive watch belonging to Nishant Singhaniya, a powerful club owner. Grateful and intrigued, Nishant brings Litika into his world, offering her a job and a place to stay.

title: Don In Uniform
description: Yash, ek underworld don, school ke ladke Rahul ko bachate hue maara gaya, aur uski aatma Rahul ke andar bas gayi. Kamzor aur bechaara Rahul, jise sab kam aankte the, ab Yash ki taakat aur swag ke saath badalne laga. Yash ne Rahul ko sambhalne aur uska graduation ka sapna poora karne ka faisla kiya. School mein Rahul hero ban gaya, ladkiyan uske charm ki deewani ho gayi. Lekin padhai aur beeta hua past uske liye badi chunauti ban gaye. Kahi Yash Rahul ko apni tarah criminal to nahi bana dega?

title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London
description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.

title: Billionaire ka Safar
description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

title: Breakup Se Bana Billionaire
description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

title: Queen Of Snakes
description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.

title: Unknown Connection
description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

title: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha
description: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha ek intense relationship thriller hai jo marriage, infidelity aur obsession ke dark side ko explore karta hai. Yeh kahani ek aurat ke tootne aur phir apne aap ko dobara khada karne ki journey hai. Show poochta hai—kya pyaar ke naam par har zulm maaf ho sakta hai? Aur jab ek aurat apni had se aage badh jaaye, toh kya woh victim rehti hai ya hunter ban jaati hai?

title: My Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
description: Hardik Goyal’s perfect life collapses when he loses his company, reputation, and fiancée overnight. Betrayed and broken, fate pulls him into the shadowy world of the mafia, where power replaces principles. As danger escalates, Hardik reconnects with Niharika, his childhood savior, discovering love, strength, and destiny. Choosing the mafia becomes his only way to protect love, family, and his future.

title: The Layoff That Shook the Company [Hindi]
description: In a high-stakes world of corporate power and betrayal, former tech prodigy Ethan finds himself caught between loyalty and revenge. As the mighty Blackwell Group crumbles due to internal politics and personal vendettas, Ethan must decide whether to save the empire that wronged him—or let it burn. A gripping tale of ambition, heartbreak, and redemption in the ruthless tech industry.

title: Sweet Revenge
description: Sweet Revenge is a dramatic tale of love, betrayal, and justice. Rachit, a devoted husband and real author behind his wife Prerna’s success, sacrifices everything for her—only to be cheated, framed, and abandoned. As truth unfolds, Rachit rises to reclaim his identity, expose deceit, and find true love, while Prerna faces the consequences of her greed. Watch now.

title: Delivery Boy Vs Billionaires
description: Billionaire is mistaken as a Delivery Boy.

title: The Billionaire's Deal
description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Yukanika , a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant , a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Yukanika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom [Tamil]
description: The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Groom is my new husband
description: Billionaire Groom is my new husband

title: My Husband Is A Ghost Hunter
description: Naina , a widowed gold magnate, marries Arjun Varma to protect her daughter and her collapsing empire, believing he is only a broken ex-convict. When powerful gold syndicates attack her business and target her child, a buried truth explodes. Her husband Arjun Varma is actually Ghost Hunter, a man once feared by governments and erased from history. As a contract marriage turns real, a caged monster rises to protect his family and claim his throne.

title: Billion Dollar Mess [Telugu]
description: When airline tycoon Veer Chopra falls for the charming flight attendant Lara Smith, he thinks he has found his perfect match. But when his unsuspecting parents, Rajesh and Vinita Chopra, fly in to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deception, and humiliation unfolds mid-air turning love into the costliest mistake of Veer’s life.

title: Vaikuntapuramlo [Telugu]
description: A successful CEO finally finds the son he lost 20 years ago after years of struggle. But just when he thinks life has given him back what he lost, shocking twists turn his world upside down. This is a family drama filled with suspense and twist upon twist.
