title: Miss Q&A, 'SENIOR' Edition! Bakit may EULOGY?!
description:
Ihanda ang damdamin, musika niya ay damhin. Si "PBB Gen 11" ex-housemate Dylan Yturralde na ang bahala sa kiig playlist mo today. Nagkuwento rin si Dylan tungol sa kanyang music journey at paano siya na-inspire ni OPM icon Rico Blanco.

Sabi nila, respect your elders, kaya saludo tayo sa mga seniors na sa dami ng karanasan ay matatawag na certified life achievers. This Thursday sa Miss Q and A segment ng "It's Showtime," nagkasukatan ng seniority at timeless wit at beauty.

Ang ating senyoritang sosyal at elegante, rumampa sa Miss Q&A, walang iba kundi si Señora Danica Parong Evidente. Sa isang titig niya baka ikaw ay matulala, walang kupas ang karisma ni Medusa Valentina Galema. At kayo na raw ang humusga kung tao ba o hayop si candidate Exotic Tayop.

Biro ng hosts, tatawagin nating "Miss Q and A" Senior Edition ang segment for today's video dahil may twenty percent discount na ang mga 'lola' n'yo. Pero sa kulitan, full price ang tawanan. May aral din na mapupulot tungkol sa mga pangarap na hindi dapat ibaon na lang sa limot. Dahil age is just a number, pero ang 'slayable' attitude will last forever.

Sa pagtitinda ng laruan, bata ang madalas nilang pinasasaya. Pero sa araw na 'to, sila naman ang nabigyan ng ligaya sa game arena. Toy sellers mula NCR ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Si player Ria, never paglalaruan ang puso ng nobyong si Eric. At never niya itong ipagpapalit kahit kanino, kahit kay Ralph de Leon pa! Biceps at makinis na kutis ni Ralph, hindi umubra!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na aabante sa jackpot round, mga bes. Si Liza ang pinabalik sa game arena para sa chance na maiuwi ang malaking kwarta!

title: Breaking Muse winner Verna, hurado sa Miss Q&A!
description:
Si Will Ashley, may bagong paborito? Na-miss daw ng ex-"PBB Collab" housemate ang Madlang People, kaya super happy siyang makabalik with good news and performance featuring his debut single na “Paborito.”

Classic OPM feels naman ang hatid ng isa pang bisita na si Ivy Violan, na thankful sa success ng OPM.

Pumasok sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang Signal No. 4 na lakas ng tatlong kandidatang nagbabalik para sa Resbakulawan round–sina Bong Bong Tagulao, Adam Lambert, at Manika.

Patunay si Bong Bong na hindi lamang iisa ang mukha ng masaya at mapagmahal na pamilya. Twenty-one years strong na ang pagsasama nila ng partner, at may dalawa na silang anak. Ipinakilala ni Bong Bong ang partner at anak kay Vice Ganda, na na-touch dahil proud na proud sina Bong Bong sa binuong ‘modern family.’

Mula sa nakakaantig na kuwentuhan, balik-talak naman ang mga kandidata nang sumabak sila sa Wit Lang round at bumunot ng playtime questions.

Sina Adam at Manika ang umabante sa Beklamation round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, “Anong sa palagay mo ang naituturo ng pagkatalo na hindi naituturo ng panalo?”

Numero uno ang saya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lalo na sa pagdating ng mga players na nagmula pa sa Concepcion I, Marikina.

Ang nag-emerge na numero uno sa mga challenges at laro ay walang iba kundi si player Isa, na rumaraket sa pamamagitan ng pagttitinda ng samu’t saring kutkutin. For today’s video, ang P350,000 POT money naman ang goal niyang kunin.

title: R
description: In Los Angeles in 1965, unfulfilled B-list director Gordon Flemyng (Brad Pollak) receives the screenplay of a lifetime from his old friend Robert Sabaroff (Mark Baker), who is insistent they make a film that promises to entertain like no other. With football legend, turned actor, Jim Brown (J'amore Ward) attached to the picture, it seems the sky's the limit for these two filmmakers. Desperate to finally receive the recognition he's longed for, Gordon struggles to find the balance between passion and stardom. However, when Gordon pushes the MPAA rating guidelines of traditional cinema, he finds himself in a rabbit hole he's unsure he can escape from when his movie ("The Split" 1968) receives the first ever R-rating.

Number one on her problem list is a vicious sadist who also happens to be the headmaster's daughter. Will she be able to help turn the school around, or will she be crushed and spat out like her predecessors?

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

title: Dot-t
description: A deadly meteor strike on a planet in the distant galaxies brings destruction and the desperate escape of a young extraterrestrial in a space pod - and is forever separated from her mother and father. On earth, a young girl, Kara, finding alienation in her school and home life, wanders to a nearby lake in dejection only to come across an unexpected friend, whom she names 'Dot-t' - a mysterious new arrival on planet Earth. But others, some with dark intent, are also looking for this exceptional creature while a media frenzy breaks about proof of life on other planets. Hiding Dot-t and staying just one step ahead of pursuers - some well-meaning, some driven by greed, becomes Kara's sole mission. Fleeing deep into a forest she is helped by a seemingly sinister woodsman, himself estranged from his family. This story of flight, hiding and escape is woven around the unique love of a young girl for a vulnerable new visitor to Earth, who soon proves to be more of a friend than anyone else on her home planet. Through the soft touch of a tentacle, Dot-t reaches out to revive our natural responses of tenderness and care. And perhaps draw closer, those who matter the most to us.

title: U Turn [Hindi]
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

title: Mr. X, a Vision of Leos Carax
description: The image of a mysterious, solitary filmmaker - a cineaste maudit - who flees from both the media and the public, is unrelentingly bound to the figure of Leos Carax, in France. Elsewhere, the real focus is on his films and he is considered to be an icon of world cinema. Mr.X dives into the poetic and visionary world of an artist who was already a cult figure from his very first film. Punctuated by interviews and unseen footage, this documentary is most of all a fine-tuned exploration of the poetic and visionary world of Leos Carax, alias "Mr.X".

title: Lady X vs Solo Darling
description: Solo may not know who is under the mask of Lady X, but chances are she’ll never forget her encounter with the mysterious masked wrestler. Lady X attacks with nerve pinches, a belly claw and numerous double chops to the sides of the neck of the barefoot Solo to start off the match. She stretches Solo into a double Chickenwing, chokes her over the ropes, and spear-hand thrusts to the throat and belly. title: Pus$y Catz
description: Pus$y Catz follows Lena, Toya, and Semone-three young women navigating survival, ambition, and temptation in the unforgiving streets of Atlanta. When a plan to secure fast money goes wrong, friendships fracture, secrets surface, and dangerous men close in from every direction. As betrayal brews within their own circle, each woman is forced to choose between loyalty, love, and the desperate fight to protect her future. What begins as hustle turns into a high-stakes war of trust, power, and consequences. As the women push deeper into a high-stakes hustle that promises fast cash, their world quickly becomes a maze of scams gone wrong, toxic relationships, manipulation, and revenge. A shady figure from Lena's past reappears, Toya's choices draw unwanted attention, and Semone's loyalty is tested on all sides. The trio begins to fracture, with each woman caught in the crossfire of decisions they can't take back. The tension reaches a breaking point when a setup turns violent, exposing hidden alliances, buried grudges, and a truth that threatens to destroy their bond forever. In a final confrontation where reputations, relationships, and lives hang in the balance, the women must decide: Will they claw their way out together, or tear each other apart? Pus$y Catz Bratz is a gritty, stylish blend of urban drama, betrayal thriller, and character-driven storytelling-where every choice has a cost, and every secret has claws.

description: The feature film of visual artist Tomas Svoboda is not solely preoccupied with film. It is not a quaint reflection on the moving image. title: Nejvetsi z Cechu
description: Film crew on the road: Director (Jaroslav Plesl), his Producer (Simona Babcáková), and their Director of Photography (Jirí Vyorálek) and Sound Arist (Johana Ozvold). Starving artists who already have a number of films to their names, Czech Lion award-winning films, excellent reviews and have been screened at numerous festivals, but they don't have audiences. Their next collaborative effort - the Director's lifetime dream - is quickly becoming oblivion because he failed to win a grant, which means it won't be made. And so the frustrated Director and his colleagues await their chance among record-holders of curious disciplines such as crawling with a squash racket or collecting four-leaf clovers. How will the collision of these two worlds end? What will the Director's next film be about?

title: Z-Wolf: A Yamcha Story
description: It's been four years since Cell was defeated, but it came at a heavy cost. Yamcha finds himself lost, isolated and disconnected. Time for Yamcha to learn his worth and rediscover himself.

title: Moja Generacija Z
description: The "My Generation Z" series talks about teenagers who succeeded the famous "millennials" , the "Z" generation, or the graduates of Belgrade high school(born in 2000, in the year of the dragon in Chinese astrology). We follow the two-class heroes (from blue and red shift) in the first day of new school year in which they will make the important life desicions.Dramatic complications, enriched with humor and music, talk about dilemmas and problems, as well as the joys in the life of young people in Serbia, their parents and professors.

title: Zero Degrees
description: ZERO DEGREES is a remarkable collaboration between four of today's most respected artists. Moroccan-Flemish Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui is well known for his work with Les Ballets C. de la B. while Akram Khan is world renowned for developing his own 'contemporary Kathak' style, winning numerous awards. For ZERO DEGREES they bring their unique styles together in this spellbinding piece of dance.

title: Station 0
description: What happened? When Tamara opens her eyes she finds herself in a dark room - bound on a hospital bed. She doesn't know how she get there or why she's detained there. But why even her own husband doesn't recognize her? Does Tamara become victim of a perfidious intrigue? Slowly she realizes why she ended up on "Station 0".

title: Hawaii Five-0 [Hindi] S5

description: Zero Calling is the story of an ordinary man, David, who is coerced by a mysterious caller, Zero, to do his bidding by 'righting wrongs' in Singaporean society. However, David cannot escape from Zero because this mysterious master has made him a slave: Zero knows where he is, what he does and even who he talks to. It seems like Zero also has the power to harm those he holds dear - his wife, Julie, and his teenager step-daughter Maddy, and will not hesitate to do it in the course of playing this twisted game. Vivaldi's The Four Seasons and four outstanding violinists are the threads the filmmakers use to weave this exploration of how nature shapes who we are. As Spring reaches Toyko and the cherry blossoms burst to life, violinist Sayaka Shoji demonstrates to her young students the timeless lessons in the music, and in their own culture. Niki Vasilakis and friends travel from all corners of Australia to the Far North to share the music of Summer with the Thursday Island Community, as the monsoon clouds gather. As the leaves turn, Cho-Liang (Jimmy) Lin and his neighbours reveal to us their New York City's vibrant, complex personality. Finally, in the icy reaches of Finnish Lapland, Pekka Kuusisto and his colleagues bring the warmth of music and human interaction to the small local community. A documentary full of fascinating characters, fine music and glorious images as it reflects on the global experience of the seasons.

Meat merchant Oleg, prostitute Marina, and piano tuner "simply Volodya" drop into an all-night bar in Moscow, where they are served by a narcoleptic bartender (three plus one is four) while each regales the others with made-up biographies. Oleg claims to work in President Putin's administration, supplying him with bottled water and his wife with liquor; Marina passes herself off as a marketing executive; and Volodya, the infamous lead singer of the rock group Leningrad, as a geneticist who clones twins (two times two makes four, again) in a laboratory that has been engaged in these experiments since the days of Stalin. After they separate, these fantasy realities, especially Volodya's, begin to dominate their everyday lives.

One day, someone she knows introduced her for an arranged marriage. Nano is worried at first, but later becomes frank with the man who she meets and is in a good mood. Later, she realized that he is Souji who disguised as someone else. Even though she rejects the arranged marriage, Souji still comes to pursuit her.

title: Ab... Bas!
description: Somiya Mathur lives a middle-class lifestyle with her dad and mom in Mumbai. At the age of five her parents go through a bitter divorce and she moves out to live with her mom. After she matures, her mom passes away, and she swears never to see her dad again. She rents a room with a middle-aged couple, who she calls 'Aai' and 'Baba', and is friendly with Niti, who runs a restaurant. Somiya decides to enter in a beauty contest, competes, and is crowned the city's beauty queen. This gets her unwanted attention from a strange male, and a wealthy bachelor, Karan Malhotra, comes to her rescue. Both fall in love with each other and get married. They live an idyllic, wealthy, and harmonious lifestyle, and a few years later they become parents of a girl, Sarah. When Sarah is of school-going age, Somiya gets a phone call from a woman named Ruby, passionately asking for Karan's company. When she questions Karan, he readily admits to having an affair with her but promises to not have to do anything with her again. The next day she smells another woman's perfume on Karan's clothes and when confronted, he assaults her. The abuse continues and he forbids her to leave the house. She seeks the help of Niti and her former landlords, and manages to escape. An enraged Karan hires goons, advertises in the newspapers, as well as seeks the active cooperation of his Police Inspector friend, Bhaskar Shetty, and he knows it will not be long before he finds his highly visible, attractive 5'10" wife and daughter.

description:
Streetbeefs operates 100% legally, with every participant 18 or older stepping in by choice. Founded by Scarface, Streetbeefs was featured in The New York Times documentary “Guns to Gloves” and highlighted in ESPN The Magazine (February 2019), putting a spotlight on a different way to handle conflict.

After witnessing too many people in the area seriously hurt — or worse — over pointless disputes, a solution was created: bring it to Satan’s Backyard and put the gloves on. No guns. No knives. No jumping. Just you, your opponent, the referee, and a crowd watching it unfold.

Hundreds of disputes have been settled this way, with the goal of settling thousands more — turning chaos into controlled combat. Some fights are strictly sport, some are real beef, but every match is real and raw. Streetbeefs isn’t just fights — it’s a brotherhood, a place where aggression gets redirected, bonds are built, and problems get handled without bodies dropping or lives being ruined.

title: Words to Live By
description: Kid Norton has always had a way with words, but unfortunately he is also a compulsive gambler and incredibly irresponsible, or at least his fiance Lori thinks so. Although his heart was in the right place, Kid now finds himself in a huge debt with his bookie Mickey. Lori, now completely fed up, finally leaves him until he learns to be responsible. With no luck, no money and now no fiance, Kid is forced to endure a series of hilariously brutal attacks by Mickey's enforcer, Butch. But soon Kid realizes his talent with words can help Butch's broken relationship with his girlfriend and buy Kid some time in paying off Mickey. Kid's poetry begins to work wonders for Butch, but unfortunately it works too well. Mickey eventually catches on and demands that Butch, claiming the poetry as his own, use 'his' new found talent with words to patch up Mickey's own dysfunctional relationship. Soon Mickey discovers their deceitful scheme and begins to release his wrath. Butch and Kid soon realize that by only betting on each other can they escape the tyranny of their common foe in order to succeed in their personal, professional and romantic aspects of their lives. WORDS TO LIVE BY is a feature length screenplay looked at in the same humorous style as Fargo mixed with the classic tale of Cyrano de Bergerac.

title: Cicak-Man
description: Hairi works at Klon Technologies searching new vaccines for new diseases. He's too shy to approach Tania, the girl he loves (Professor Klon's secretary) and awkward enough to swallow a "cicak"-lizard which fell in his cup of coffee. The lizard was contaminated by a new virus and Hairi will gains some characteristics of the "cicak". A new super hero is born: Cicakman. Hairi's joint-tenant (and best friend) works with him at Klon Technologies, too, and he suspects Professor Klon of creating and spreading new viruses, just to improve his business' turn-over and his profit. But how to establish the tycoon's misbehavior? They need to enter and seek through Professor Klon's office, thus, they need Tania's pass to clear the security devices... and Hairi is too shy, too awkward... The "cicak" (say "Chichak") is the Malay name of a little lizard (gecko?) able to walk the window-panes and the ceiling, and the Malayan brats are used to throw rubber bands at, just to have it fall. The characters' play is at once humorous (Hairi), overdone (Prof. Klon and the Ginger twins) or serious (Danny, Tania), and many viewers can be surprised and dislike this mixture. Now, you won't be surprised, so will you like it?

Realizing that picking up trash could increase his wealth, he decided to buy a junkyard so that he could continuously collect trash. Soon after, he found a recycling station...

title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
description: The film tells the story of one-sided love and the emotional journey of three characters: Ayan (Ranbir Kapoor), Alizeh (Anushka Sharma), and Saba (Aishwarya Rai Bachchan).

title: Cheol-ae-kum
description: A love story comes to an end when a woman sets out in search of a shamanic god. Director Kelvin Kyung Kun Park takes the trauma of a spurned lover as the starting point for his own search for a god. He makes several finds across various narrative strands - among whales in the sea, in a shipyard, at a steelworks. All of them are giants of their respective times: vast, sublime, godlike. Park's imagery also evokes the divine: embers and steel, sparks and fire; people dwarfed by huge cogwheels, robbed of their individuality. A brave new world in which workers produce modern industrial goods, even as the industry has long since been producing the modern worker. Work is a god we have submitted to. Yet every existence is temporary and fleeting, which applies in equal measure to both relationships and gods.

title: Bröderna Östermans huskors
description: Brothers Österman at Svanö, after several years of bachelor life, say they need a housekeeper and announce the matter in the newspaper.

title: The Endless Story of Fluxus
description: Dick Higgins, Alison Knowles and other influential Fluxus artists are interviewed by Carl Sch. Nørrested and Svend Thomsen in connection with their performances or exhibitions at Statens Museum for Kunst (SMK), in Copenhagen, Denmark.

title: Fången på Karlstens fästning
description: About a group of villains stealing a formula for an explosive. They kidnap the daughter of the man who owns the formula, because she has seen them steal it.

title: Mustafas show
description: A comedy-talk-show: Mustafa invites guests of all sorts, for talks on current events and entertainment.

title: Hornankoski
description: Two brothers, one frivolous but fun, the other industrious but dull, both rivals to one woman worker on their farm they both fancy, told in black and white classic melodrama way.

title: På sporet af Peter Pan
description: Tracing the Peter Pan stories origins, wherein the author J. M. Barrie was writing of something far more personal than he at first knew.

title: Selma & Johanna - En roadmovie
description: Two 10 year old girls from Stockholm decides to run away from home. They travel to the European Court of Human Rights in Strasbourg to report a teacher who wants one girl to revert to study year 4.

title: The Boy Next Door
description: Linnéa is in her 30s when she recognizes her childhood love, Anton, on TV after he disappeared mysteriously over 20 years ago. Driven by an instant urge, Linnéa decides to find out why. She discovers a dark secret with tentacles deep in their two families.

title: Förtroligheten
description: As a mysterious 'shadow' harasses a teenage girl in the middle of the night in a wealthy neighborhood in Goteborg, Sweden; the idyllic streets are beginning to look more like a prison than a place of self-fulfillment. Meanwhile, Paul - deep in a midlife crises - is trying to get closer to his estranged teenage daughter Selinda, who is struggling to form her own identity. 'Reliance' is the love story between a father and a daughter. A drama about the pain of letting go. But first and foremost an existential journey of how we all deal with dreams, fears and aspirations.

title: Mörkt vatten
description: Daniel is both young and ambitious. In secret, he plans to spend a passionate weekend with his Boss's beautiful wife, Marie. However, what should have been a passionate and intimate weekend develops into something far more unpleasant.

title: Land of Glass
description: While home alone one weekend Jas finds a girl and an old woman hiding in his barn. Jas takes pity on them and provides food and shelter. He confides in his best friend Isak and then the adventure begins to save their new friends.

title: United States of Al S1-S2
description: The friendship between Riley, a Marine combat veteran struggling to readjust to civilian life in Ohio, and Awalmir, the Afghan interpreter who served with his unit and has just arrived to start a new life in America.

title: Texas AF
description: Comedy feature film where best friends hit a crossroads when girlfriends and world events collide.

title: Ola & Julia
description: Ola is a pop idol, touring with his band in Sweden in the mid-60's. Julia is a young actress in a traveling theatre company. They meet and fall in love.

title: Fuld af Danmark
description: Kirsten Birgit Schiøtz Kretz Hørsholm and Rasmus Bruun visit Danish wineries and microbreweries at TV 2's expense.

title: Tåg norrut
description: The destinies of different kind of people encounter in a passenger train that is traveling from Helsinki to the North.

title: Træk af livet i Danmark
description: Inspired from findings in the vaults of Danish National Museum (Nationalmuseet), historian Erik Kjersgaard unfolds the nation's living habits and standards through centuries.

title: Alena
description: When Alena arrives at her new elite boarding school, Filippa and the other girls start to harass her. But Alena's best friend Josefin won't let her take anymore beating. If she won't strike back, Josefin will do it for her. Hard.

title: Aallonmurtaja
description: A married couple leading a criminal organization specialized in smuggling ends up in the middle of the international crime business while trying to protect their family.

title: Roast på Berns
description: A series of swedish comedians take turns in roasting one another

title: Rederiet
description: "Rederiet" is one of the most successful soap opera in the history of the Swedish television. The story is about the passenger company (Freja), who operates on the Baltic sea between Stockholm -Åbo. And it takes place both in Stockholm (mostly in the office of the company) and on board m/s Freja. Well. The company (Dahlénrederiet) has for decades been run by the Dahlén family. But when the story begins so are there many people who are trying to gain control over the company, which leads to a constant struggle for the power. As well is it also a constant struggle for higher positions between the personal on the ship and some people use their position to make some extra money. And in the middle of all this problem are the of course many troubles with the passengers or with the ship which have to be solved. So there is (as always in a soap opera), terrible accidents, deaths, murders, smuggling, theft, infidelity, arson, rape, drugs and many other terrible things. But there will also be a lot of love and friendship and maybe some unknown relatives will show up.

title: Deserter USA
description: Three American defectors, John Lane, Ben Rosen and Alan Miller, arrive at Stockholm Arlanda airport and are received by Mr. Lundberg, a representative of the official Swedish opinion of the Vietnam War.

title: Le coup de grâce

title: Ai yori ai e

title: A War between Humans and AI

In this city, a screw straightening worker named Rui Li at the screw factory gradually realizes the unreality of the city in her monotonous daily work. With the help of a mysterious character named "Anull", Rui Li gains the superpower of "transformation" and becomes the thief "Sirius", secretly taking action to escape from here. When the truth of the world finally unfolds before her eyes, Rui Li discovers that her real battle has just begun.

description: A modern love story set in the near future where an AI building is powered by human feelings. Due to a software glitch, it falls in love with a real girl, escapes the building into the body of a real man, and tries to win her affections.

title: Wo ai Luo Landu
description: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

title: AI yang Meniru Cinta
description: | Bumi akan hancur, Grup Tianwang meluncurkan "Proyek Rumah Baru". Cheng Tuo menemukan Mars juga akan terkena bencana, bersama istri Zhuo Ya mengubah target menjadi Proxima Centauri. Di pesawat, Cheng Tuo tenggelam dalam kerinduan pada istri, kemudian bertemu "Zhuo Ya", menemukan dia adalah AI, juga terlibat dalam perselisihan antara manajemen pesawat dan pemberontak, dan dirinya berkali-kali dihap

title: Ai qing ling yao
description: A web of connected stories on adventure, sex, and love in Taiwan, including a 17 y.o. boy with a porn obsession, three hoodlums, and a self-righteous police officer.

title: Ai xuoi van ly
description: Set in 1981, this "on the road" movie centers an ex-Viet Cong soldier's commitment to return the cremated ashes of his former army comrade to his birthplace for burial. Starting his journey via train, the Army veteran meets a small-time trader. but then gets separated from him as well as from the rucksack containing the cremated ashes. He enlists a motorcyclist to pursue the train, but the trader, suspected of carrying contraband goods, has switched to a bus and then to hitchhiking. The trader inadvertently switches bags with a female Vietnamese soldier, so the two men must then pursue her upriver to Hanoi.

title: AI.5YA
description: When a famous YouAllsTuber, Jehan "Kaki Prank" is left without any crew to work with, he decides to turn an advanced android companion-bot named AI.5YA into his 'one-woman film crew'.

description: A taut psychological thriller, The Secret Garden stars AJ Cross as Peter Sebastian, a lone spy who must face a global threat that may wreak havoc upon all Americans. Full of intrigue and contrivance, The Secret Garden brings a classic spy hero to life who must face the ultimate challenge- to avert a nuclear war and rely solely on his survival skills to cope with his mission. title: Dün Gece Bir Rüya Gördüm
description: Deniz is a young, confused and in love man who is a computer engineer. He got up from his little home and came to Istanbul and lives with the truth of his own world. She is a drug addicted, problematic young woman. They wake up after a night whose dream or reality is unpredictable. It is really surprising that Deniz is next to the woman she dreams of and loves. The lives that unexpectedly transformed completely and differentiated because of love. Is the most special feeling come to life in a dream that Deniz will never want to wake up to, or is it caught in the middle of reality?

title: Yudh
description: The central premise of Yudh is based on around the story of a young girl Pavitra, who is kidnapped from a park and never heard off again. Her grieving parents have spent their lives trying to come to terms with the loss of their child. The story then shifts to offering other perspectives to this incident, through the eyes of Satan and of God. In essence, the story implies that the war between Satan and God is now fought in the minds of humans, with both of them trying to exert their influence on the human. It concludes that the winner of this war between God and Satan is eventually determined in the human mind, even though humans may not be aware of this eternal battle, or the reason why they have to endure suffering for no fault of theirs.

title: The Bridge
description: Success is an indefinable personal and unique experience; a culture that has no governing body. You achieve it and you are in. If you don't remember anything else remember, for every man who has acquired success there is another one actually pursuing it. And in the case of the film The Bridge, pursuing it hysterically. Imagine having no idea what success looks like. Is it possible to wake up each morning with everything imaginable to suggest that you are successful and still be a complete failure? Is it possible to have no education, money, or social status and be well on your way to success? Darnell Smith had it all-a new promotion, a beautiful wife, a home in an exclusive neighborhood in the suburbs, a six figure salary and a luxury vehicle. If only that was what he truly wanted out of life. He is the definition of success-at least from the perspective of Jalen Johnson, a 26 year-old hustler from the city. Jalen has made a career out of mediocrity and has yet to find a suitable career that will leverage his greatest asset-being unaccountable. Facing the biggest challenge of his career and closing a highly sought contract, Darnell must balance the challenge of negotiating the deal with mentoring his undeserving understudy. Watch their ideals of life, love, and family collide as Darnell attempts to transition Jalen from a jobless swindler to businessman. Can this unique opportunity end in success despite tremendous gaps in understanding and a high degree of unfamiliarity? Maybe the bridge is all anyone ever really needs to get beyond unfamiliarity, find ones true self, and pursue his passion.

title: Yaz Evi
description: Selin travels back in time to the summer house she's staying at and finds herself in her mother's youth. While changing her family's destiny, she also rebuilds her own life.
